records.summary_zh: 心臟瓣膜疾病包含心臟瓣膜的狹窄、逆流及其他功能障礙，可能改變心內血流並導致心室重塑、心律不整或心臟衰竭。
records.summary_en: Valvular heart disease comprises stenosis, regurgitation and other dysfunction of the heart valves that can alter intracardiac flow and lead to chamber remodeling, arrhythmia or heart failure.
records.etiology_zh: 病因包含先天性異常、退化性鈣化、風濕性疾病、感染性心內膜炎、缺血性／乳突肌功能障礙，以及結締組織疾病。此為上位分類概念，主動脈瓣狹窄、二尖瓣逆流等個別瓣膜疾病，依現有正典涵蓋範圍與介面需求，可能值得建立獨立的子記錄。
records.etiology_en: Causes include congenital abnormalities, degenerative calcification, rheumatic disease, infective endocarditis, ischemic/papillary muscle dysfunction and connective-tissue disease. This is a parent condition; aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation and other valve-specific disorders may deserve separate child identities depending current canonical coverage and UI needs.
records.western_pathology_zh: 狹窄會阻礙前向血流；逆流則造成逆向血流與容積負荷過重。長期的壓力／容積負荷可能導致心室或心房重塑並演變為心臟衰竭。
records.western_pathology_en: Stenosis obstructs forward flow; regurgitation causes backward flow and volume overload. Chronic pressure/volume stress can produce ventricular/atrial remodeling and heart failure.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：本記錄屬於上位分類。個別瓣膜特異性疾病（如主動脈瓣狹窄、二尖瓣逆流）可能需要依現況再另立子記錄，各自完整記載，再以多對多方式連結，而非把所有瓣膜病理全部併入本記錄。

臨床表現：部分病人無症狀。可能出現呼吸困難、疲勞、胸部不適、心悸、暈厥、水腫或運動耐受不良，依受累瓣膜與嚴重度而異。

重要特徵：屬於帶有瓣膜特異性亞型的上位分類；心雜音提示但不能定義嚴重度；心臟超音波檢查為核心；嚴重瓣膜疾病可能導致心臟衰竭／暈厥。

診斷方法：病史／理學檢查與心臟超音波為核心，依情境可加做心電圖、胸部影像、壓力測試、電腦斷層／核磁共振或心導管檢查。

鑑別診斷：其他病因造成的心臟衰竭、心肌病變、先天性心臟病、心律不整，以及非心因性呼吸困難。

西醫治療：處置依病灶與嚴重度而定，包含觀察追蹤、針對併發症的指引導向藥物治療，以及外科或經導管瓣膜修復／置換。

編碼備註：確切編碼須於個案登錄時核對當年度CDC/NCHS ICD-10-CM，並依已記錄的瓣膜、亞型、急慢性或併發症而定。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: This is a parent condition. Aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation and other valve-specific disorders may deserve separate child identities depending current canonical coverage and UI needs — each fully documented, connected many-to-many, rather than merging all valve pathology into this one record.

Clinical presentation: Some patients are asymptomatic. Dyspnea, fatigue, chest discomfort, palpitations, syncope, edema or exercise intolerance can occur depending valve and severity.

Key features: parent category with valve-specific subtypes; murmur suggests but does not define severity; echocardiography is central; severe valve disease can cause HF/syncope.

Diagnostic approach: History/exam and echocardiography are central; ECG, chest imaging, stress testing, CT/MRI or catheterization can add information by context.

Differential diagnosis: heart failure from other causes, cardiomyopathy, congenital heart disease, arrhythmia, noncardiac dyspnea.

Western treatment: Observation, guideline-directed medical management of consequences, and valve repair or replacement (surgical or transcatheter) depend on lesion and severity.

Coding note: verify the active fiscal-year CDC/NCHS ICD-10-CM at the time of coding, per documented valve, subtype, acuity, or complication.

records.summary_zh: 慢性腎臟病是持續三個月以上的腎損傷或腎功能下降，伴隨心血管、代謝與疾病進展風險。
records.summary_en: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is persistent kidney damage or reduced kidney function lasting more than three months and carrying cardiovascular, metabolic and progression risks.
records.etiology_zh: 常見病因包括糖尿病、高血壓、腎絲球疾病、遺傳性腎病、阻塞與反覆腎損傷。
records.etiology_en: Common causes include diabetes, hypertension, glomerular disease, inherited disease, obstruction and recurrent kidney injury.
records.western_pathology_zh: 腎元進行性喪失導致過濾能力下降與內分泌／代謝功能紊亂，包括水分、電解質、酸鹼平衡、貧血與骨礦物質相關併發症。
records.western_pathology_en: Progressive nephron loss causes reduced filtration and endocrine/metabolic disturbances, including fluid, electrolyte, acid-base, anemia and mineral-bone complications.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：CKD 不是單一次肌酸酐數值異常，分期須結合估算腎絲球過濾率（eGFR）與白蛋白尿等腎損傷證據。

臨床表現：早期常無症狀，後期可能出現疲勞、水腫、皮膚搔癢、噁心、食慾改變、呼吸困難、睡眠問題與排尿變化。

重要特徵：持續超過三個月才符合定義；eGFR 與尿白蛋白為核心檢驗；心血管風險顯著升高；晚期 CKD 影響用藥與處置安全性。

診斷方法：以血清肌酸酐／eGFR 與尿白蛋白肌酸酐比為核心，並依情況加做尿液分析、影像與病因相關檢查。

鑑別診斷：急性腎損傷、脫水導致的暫時性肌酸酐上升、阻塞性尿路病變、心臟／肝臟相關水腫。

西醫治療：治療病因、控制血壓／血糖、依適應症使用腎臟保護藥物、避免腎毒性物質、處理併發症，晚期需規劃腎臟替代治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對分期與病因。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: CKD is not a single creatinine result. Staging incorporates estimated GFR and albuminuria/other evidence of kidney damage.

Clinical presentation: Often asymptomatic early; later fatigue, edema, pruritus, nausea, appetite change, dyspnea, sleep problems and urinary changes may occur.

Key features: persistence >3 months matters; eGFR and urine albumin are core tests; cardiovascular risk is high; advanced CKD affects medication/procedure safety.

Diagnostic approach: Serum creatinine/eGFR and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio are central; urinalysis, imaging and cause-specific testing are added as indicated.

Differential diagnosis: acute kidney injury, dehydration-related transient creatinine rise, obstructive uropathy, heart/liver-related edema.

Western treatment: Treat cause, control BP/diabetes, use kidney-protective therapies when indicated, avoid nephrotoxins, manage complications and plan renal replacement therapy for kidney failure when necessary.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Coordinate treatment plan and medications with the patient's nephrologist; never advise the patient to independently adjust medication

records.summary_zh: 腎結石是泌尿道內的固態礦物質／結晶沉積物，可造成腎絞痛、血尿與尿路阻塞。
records.summary_en: Kidney stones are solid mineral/crystal deposits in the urinary tract that can cause renal colic, hematuria and obstruction.
records.etiology_zh: 危險因子包括尿量過低、尿液化學成分異常、飲食、代謝性疾病、感染、藥物及遺傳因子，依結石成分而異。
records.etiology_en: Risk reflects low urine volume, urinary chemistry, diet, metabolic disease, infection, medications and genetic factors depending on stone type.
records.western_pathology_zh: 結晶形成並聚集成石，遷移進入輸尿管時可能阻塞尿流、升高壓力並造成劇烈絞痛。
records.western_pathology_en: Crystals form and aggregate; migration into the ureter can obstruct urine flow, raise pressure and cause severe colicky pain.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：結石疾病涵蓋不同成分與解剖位置；併發感染的阻塞性結石屬高風險急症。

臨床表現：劇烈側腹／背痛並放射至鼠蹊部、血尿、噁心嘔吐與尿急。

重要特徵：絞痛型側腹痛；血尿常見；常用非顯影劑影像檢查；感染合併阻塞屬危險狀態。

診斷方法：尿液分析、血液檢查與影像確認結石／阻塞；反覆發作者可用取出之結石與 24 小時尿液分析指導預防。

鑑別診斷：腎盂腎炎、闌尾炎、主動脈疾病、膽絞痛、肌肉骨骼疼痛、子宮外孕。

西醫治療：止痛、適度輸液、部分病人可用藥物排石治療，阻塞性／大型／複雜結石需泌尿科處置；預防依結石成分而定。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對亞型、急性度與併發症。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Stone disease includes different compositions and anatomical locations; a stone causing infected obstruction is a high-risk emergency state.

Clinical presentation: Severe flank/back pain radiating toward the groin, hematuria, nausea/vomiting and urinary urgency can occur.

Key features: colicky flank pain; hematuria common; noncontrast imaging often used; infection plus obstruction is dangerous.

Diagnostic approach: Urinalysis, blood tests and imaging identify stone/obstruction; recovered stones and 24-hour urine can guide prevention in recurrent disease.

Differential diagnosis: pyelonephritis, appendicitis, aortic disease, biliary colic, musculoskeletal pain, ectopic pregnancy.

Western treatment: Pain control, hydration as appropriate, medical expulsive therapy in selected cases, and urologic procedures for obstructing/large/complicated stones; prevention is stone-specific.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_en.rationale: Needs aggressive pain control and possible intervention
Imaging and medication choices must account for pregnancy safety

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 病情穩定的結石相關疼痛可作輔助照護，但不可取代阻塞、感染或血管／腹腔急症的評估
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不明原因急性側腹痛未經影像／檢驗排除阻塞或感染前，不應逕行以氣滯或腎虛論治
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 若懷疑阻塞、感染或結石無法自行排出，轉診泌尿科評估
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch F Respiratory/Renal/Sleep（依據 NIDDK 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於腎結石的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Adjunctive care may support stable stone-related pain, but must not delay evaluation of obstruction, infection or vascular/abdominal emergencies
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not treat undiagnosed acute flank pain as simple qi stagnation or kidney deficiency before obstruction/infection are excluded by imaging/labs
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Refer to urology when obstruction, infection or a non-passing stone is suspected
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch F Respiratory/Renal/Sleep (compiled from NIDDK clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for kidney stones was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 腎盂腎炎是腎臟的感染，通常為細菌性，常由下泌尿道感染上行造成。
records.summary_en: Pyelonephritis is an infection of the kidney, usually bacterial and often ascending from the lower urinary tract.
records.etiology_zh: 多數病例源自泌尿道細菌上行至腎臟；阻塞、懷孕、膀胱輸尿管逆流、導尿管與泌尿道結構異常會提高風險。
records.etiology_en: Most cases arise from urinary bacteria ascending to the kidney; obstruction, pregnancy, reflux, catheters and urinary abnormalities can increase risk.
records.western_pathology_zh: 細菌感染造成腎組織與集尿系統發炎，可能併發菌血症／敗血症。
records.western_pathology_en: Bacterial infection produces inflammation of renal tissue and collecting system; bacteremia/sepsis can occur.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：腎臟感染比單純膀胱炎更為嚴重，可能導致敗血症或腎臟併發症。

臨床表現：發燒寒顫、側腹或背痛、噁心嘔吐與泌尿道症狀常見。

重要特徵：屬上泌尿道感染；發燒合併側腹痛為高辨識度組合；尿液檢驗／培養重要；有敗血症風險。

診斷方法：尿液分析與尿液培養；病情嚴重、表現不典型、反覆發作或疑似阻塞時加做血液檢查與影像。

鑑別診斷：膀胱炎、腎結石、闌尾炎、肌肉骨骼側腹痛、骨盆腔發炎疾病。

西醫治療：依嚴重度與抗藥性風險選擇抗生素及給藥途徑／照護場所，並處理阻塞或結構性病因。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對亞型、急性度與併發症。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Kidney infection is more serious than uncomplicated cystitis and can cause sepsis or renal complications.

Clinical presentation: Fever/chills, flank or back pain, nausea/vomiting and urinary symptoms are common.

Key features: upper urinary tract infection; fever plus flank pain is high-yield; urine testing/culture important; sepsis risk.

Diagnostic approach: Urinalysis and urine culture; blood tests and imaging when severe, atypical, recurrent or obstruction is suspected.

Differential diagnosis: cystitis, nephrolithiasis, appendicitis, musculoskeletal flank pain, pelvic inflammatory disease.

Western treatment: Antibiotics with route/setting based on severity and resistance risk; address obstruction or structural cause.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

感染合併阻塞需緊急引流

red_flags_zh.rationale: 需靜脈輸液與抗生素

High maternal-fetal risk, requires immediate antibiotics
Infection with obstruction requires urgent drainage

Higher risk of infection progression

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不適用於急性發燒性側腹痛的針灸治療；僅可於感染控制且穩定後提供恢復期輔助照護
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不可把發燒合併側腹痛視為單純腎虛論治；系統性感染／不穩定期間應暫緩治療
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 感染控制與抗生素治療期間由西醫主導，執業者應聯絡開藥醫師，不建議病人自行停用抗生素
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch F Respiratory/Renal/Sleep（依據 NIDDK 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於腎盂腎炎的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not applicable to acute febrile flank pain; adjunctive recovery-phase support only once infection is controlled and the patient is stable
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not treat febrile flank pain as simple Kidney deficiency; defer treatment during systemic infection/instability
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Infection control and antibiotic therapy are led by the treating physician; practitioners must not advise stopping antibiotics
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch F Respiratory/Renal/Sleep (compiled from NIDDK clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for pyelonephritis was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 急性細菌性膀胱炎是膀胱的感染／發炎，會造成下泌尿道症狀。
records.summary_en: Acute bacterial cystitis is infection/inflammation of the bladder causing lower urinary tract symptoms.
records.etiology_zh: 多由細菌經尿道上行造成，解剖構造、性行為、停經、懷孕、阻塞與器械操作會影響風險。
records.etiology_en: Usually caused by bacteria ascending through the urethra; risk is influenced by anatomy, sexual activity, menopause, pregnancy, obstruction and instrumentation.
records.western_pathology_zh: 細菌定殖引發膀胱黏膜發炎，造成排尿疼痛、尿急與頻尿。
records.western_pathology_en: Bacterial colonization triggers bladder mucosal inflammation, causing dysuria, urgency and frequency.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：膀胱炎與無症狀菌尿、腎盂腎炎、性傳染病／尿道炎及間質性膀胱炎／膀胱疼痛症候群是不同的臨床概念（本卡與 `cond.interstitial_cystitis`〔間質性膀胱炎〕、`cond.recurrent_uti`〔反覆泌尿道感染〕為互相獨立但可能重疊的實體，非同一疾病）。

臨床表現：排尿疼痛、頻尿／尿急、恥骨上不適，有時血尿；若合併發燒／側腹痛則提示上泌尿道侵犯。

重要特徵：屬下泌尿道感染；出現全身症狀時須排除腎盂腎炎；懷孕會改變處置方式。

診斷方法：臨床評估搭配尿液分析；複雜或反覆病例加做尿液培養。

鑑別診斷：腎盂腎炎、尿道炎／性傳染病、陰道炎、間質性膀胱炎、腎結石。

西醫治療：細菌性膀胱炎給予適當抗生素並提供支持性照護；反覆／複雜病例需評估病因。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對亞型、急性度與併發症。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Cystitis is distinct from asymptomatic bacteriuria, pyelonephritis, STI/urethritis and interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome — kept as a separate identity from `cond.interstitial_cystitis` and `cond.recurrent_uti` already in canon (overlapping but non-equivalent entities).

Clinical presentation: Dysuria, urinary frequency/urgency, suprapubic discomfort and sometimes hematuria; fever/flank pain suggests upper-tract involvement.

Key features: lower UTI; dysuria/frequency/urgency; pyelonephritis must be excluded when systemic symptoms occur; pregnancy changes management.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical assessment plus urinalysis; urine culture in selected/complicated cases.

Differential diagnosis: pyelonephritis, urethritis/STI, vaginitis, interstitial cystitis, nephrolithiasis.

Western treatment: Appropriate antibiotics for bacterial cystitis plus supportive care; recurrent/complicated cases need cause evaluation.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 女性生理構造（尿道較短）
留置導尿管或器械操作

red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 轉診評估上泌尿道感染
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能提示已進展為腎盂腎炎
口服抗生素治療失敗風險

red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 轉診婦產科評估與治療
red_flags_zh.rationale: 未治療的膀胱炎可能上行感染，影響妊娠

red_flags_zh.finding: 男性或反覆複雜性感染
red_flags_zh.rationale: 男性泌尿道感染較不典型，需排除結構性病因
可能需要導尿或進一步處置

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Refer for upper urinary tract infection evaluation
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate progression to pyelonephritis

red_flags_en.finding: Vomiting, unable to take oral medication
red_flags_en.rationale: Risk of oral antibiotic treatment failure

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Refer to obstetrics for evaluation and treatment
red_flags_en.rationale: Untreated cystitis may ascend and affect pregnancy

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Refer to urology to evaluate cause
red_flags_en.rationale: UTI in males is atypical and warrants exclusion of structural cause
May require catheterization or further management

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 確診細菌性膀胱炎且已接受抗生素治療者，可作症狀輔助照護；不可以針灸取代抗生素治療已確診感染
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 發燒或側腹痛須先排除上泌尿道感染；輔助照護不應延誤抗生素起始時間
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與開立抗生素之醫師確認治療進度，反覆發作者建議轉診泌尿科查找病因
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch F Respiratory/Renal/Sleep（依據 NIDDK 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於膀胱炎的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Adjunctive symptom support once bacterial cystitis is diagnosed and on antibiotics; acupuncture must not replace antibiotics for diagnosed infection
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Adjunctive care should not delay antibiotics when infection is diagnosed; fever/flank pain requires upper-tract infection to be excluded first
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Coordinate with the prescribing physician on treatment progress; refer recurrent cases to urology for cause evaluation
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch F Respiratory/Renal/Sleep (compiled from NIDDK clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for cystitis was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 肺炎是肺泡與周邊組織的感染／發炎，可由細菌、病毒、黴菌或其他病原體造成。
records.summary_en: Pneumonia is infection/inflammation of lung air sacs and surrounding tissue caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi or other pathogens.
records.etiology_zh: 常見病因包括細菌與病毒病原體；吸入性肺炎與免疫低下狀態會改變致病菌與風險輪廓。
records.etiology_en: Common causes include bacterial and viral pathogens; aspiration and immunocompromised states alter the pathogen/risk profile.
records.western_pathology_zh: 肺泡發炎與滲出液堆積影響氣體交換，並可能引發全身性發炎反應。
records.western_pathology_en: Alveolar inflammation and fluid/cellular exudate impair gas exchange and can provoke systemic inflammatory response.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：肺炎屬下呼吸道感染，與急性支氣管炎及單純上呼吸道感染不同。

臨床表現：咳嗽、發燒寒顫、呼吸困難、胸痛、疲勞與痰液可能出現；老年或免疫低下病人表現可能不典型。

重要特徵：屬下呼吸道感染；可能影響氣體交換；影像檢查常有助診斷；嚴重度決定門診或住院照護。

診斷方法：病史／理學檢查、血氧評估，常搭配胸部影像；依嚴重度與情境加做病原學檢測。

鑑別診斷：急性支氣管炎、流感／COVID、氣喘／慢性阻塞性肺病急性惡化、肺栓塞、心衰竭。

西醫治療：依病因與嚴重度給予抗微生物藥物及支持性照護；重症可能需住院與呼吸支持。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對病原、亞型與併發症。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Pneumonia is a lower respiratory infection and is distinct from acute bronchitis and uncomplicated upper respiratory infection.

Clinical presentation: Cough, fever/chills, dyspnea, chest pain, fatigue and sputum may occur; older or immunocompromised patients can present atypically.

Key features: lower respiratory infection; gas-exchange impairment possible; imaging often supports diagnosis; severity determines outpatient vs hospital care.

Diagnostic approach: History/exam, oxygen assessment and often chest imaging; microbiologic testing depends on severity and context.

Differential diagnosis: acute bronchitis, influenza/COVID, asthma/COPD exacerbation, pulmonary embolism, heart failure.

Western treatment: Cause- and severity-specific antimicrobials when indicated plus supportive care; severe disease may require hospitalization and respiratory support.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示呼吸衰竭風險
重症肺炎的危險徵象
可能提示敗血症或缺氧
敗血性休克警訊
可能需要靜脈輸液支持

red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests risk of respiratory failure
Danger sign of severe pneumonia
May indicate sepsis or hypoxia
Warning sign of septic shock
May require IV fluid support

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不適用於不穩定或低血氧的急性肺炎；恢復期穩定病人可作症狀輔助照護
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 感染控制與轉診優先於針灸治療；急性期不予治療
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與治療中的醫師聯絡確認病情穩定度，不建議病人自行停用抗微生物藥物
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch F Respiratory/Renal/Sleep（依據 NHLBI 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於肺炎的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not applicable to unstable or hypoxic acute pneumonia; adjunctive support only for stable patients in recovery
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Infection-control and referral come first; do not treat during the acute unstable phase
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Confirm clinical stability with the treating physician; never advise stopping antimicrobial therapy
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch F Respiratory/Renal/Sleep (compiled from NHLBI clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for pneumonia was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 癲癇是一種慢性腦部疾病，特徵為持續存在反覆發生非誘發性癲癇發作的傾向。
records.summary_en: Epilepsy is a chronic brain disorder characterized by an enduring predisposition to recurrent unprovoked seizures.
records.etiology_zh: 病因包含遺傳性、結構性、代謝性、免疫性、感染性與不明原因等分類。
records.etiology_en: Causes include genetic, structural, metabolic, immune, infectious and unknown factors.
records.western_pathology_zh: 異常的神經元過度同步放電造成意識、動作、感覺、行為或自律神經功能的短暫改變。
records.western_pathology_en: Abnormal hypersynchronous neuronal activity produces transient alterations in awareness, movement, sensation, behavior or autonomic function.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：單次誘發性癲癇發作不等於癲癇；發作類型與癲癇症候群分類會影響診斷與治療。

臨床表現：發作型態多樣，從局部感覺／行為事件到意識受損、抽搐或短暫全身性發作皆有可能。

重要特徵：反覆性非誘發癲癇發作；發作分類很重要；腦電圖與影像常用；用藥遵從性與安全性至關重要。

診斷方法：詳細病史／目擊者描述、神經學檢查、腦電圖、腦部影像，並以檢驗找出誘發因子／病因。

鑑別診斷：暈厥、心因性非癲癇發作、偏頭痛、暫時性腦缺血、低血糖。

西醫治療：抗癲癇藥物為主要治療；頑固性癲癇可考慮手術、裝置或飲食治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: A single provoked seizure is not automatically epilepsy. Seizure type and epilepsy syndrome classification affect diagnosis and treatment.

Clinical presentation: Seizures vary from focal sensory/behavioral events to impaired awareness, convulsions or brief generalized events.

Key features: recurrent unprovoked seizures; seizure classification matters; EEG and imaging often used; medication adherence/safety are critical.

Diagnostic approach: Detailed event history/witness description, neurologic exam, EEG, brain imaging and labs to identify provocation/cause.

Differential diagnosis: syncope, psychogenic nonepileptic events, migraine, TIA, hypoglycemia.

Western treatment: Antiseizure medicines are mainstay; surgery, devices and dietary therapies are used in selected refractory epilepsy.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 腦部感染病史（如腦膜炎、腦炎）

risk_factors_en.factor: History of brain infection (e.g., meningitis, encephalitis)

red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除急性結構性或代謝性病因

red_flags_zh.finding: 癲癇重積狀態（持續或反覆發作未恢復意識）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 屬神經急症，有致命風險
需評估外傷本身與發作病因
需同時考量母胎安全
可能為非抽搐性癲癇重積狀態

red_flags_en.rationale: Must exclude acute structural or metabolic cause

red_flags_en.finding: Status epilepticus (prolonged or repeated seizures without recovery)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Call emergency services / go to ER immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: Neurologic emergency with life-threatening risk
Must evaluate both the injury and the cause of the seizure
Must consider both maternal and fetal safety
May indicate nonconvulsive status epilepticus

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 穩定期病人可作輔助照護（如壓力／睡眠相關症狀），不可取代抗癲癇藥物治療
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 急性發作期間不予針刺；需先了解病人的抗癲癇藥物治療、誘發因子與急救計畫
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的神經科醫師聯絡確認用藥與發作控制狀況，不建議病人自行調整或停用抗癲癇藥物
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch G Neurology（依據 NINDS 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於癲癇的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Adjunctive support for stable patients (e.g., stress/sleep-related symptoms) only; cannot replace antiseizure medication
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not needle during uncontrolled acute seizure activity; review the patient's antiseizure medicine, triggers and rescue plan first
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's neurologist to confirm medication and seizure control status; never advise the patient to independently adjust or stop antiseizure medication
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch G Neurology (compiled from NINDS clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for epilepsy was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

aliases_zh: 急性發炎性脫髓鞘多發神經病變
records.summary_zh: 格林-巴利症候群是急性免疫介導的周邊神經病變，可造成快速進展的無力、感覺症狀與自律神經功能障礙。
records.summary_en: Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) is an acute immune-mediated peripheral neuropathy that can cause rapidly progressive weakness, sensory symptoms and autonomic dysfunction.
records.etiology_zh: 常於感染後發生，免疫反應錯誤攻擊周邊神經。
records.etiology_en: Often follows an infection; immune responses mistakenly attack peripheral nerves.
records.western_pathology_zh: 免疫介導的髓鞘脫失及／或軸突損傷損害周邊神經傳導，可能波及呼吸相關神經。
records.western_pathology_en: Immune-mediated demyelination and/or axonal injury impairs peripheral nerve conduction, potentially including respiratory nerves.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：格林-巴利症候群屬於神經急症光譜，與慢性周邊神經病變及重症肌無力不同。

臨床表現：對稱性無力常從下肢開始並向上蔓延，可伴隨刺痛、疼痛、反射減弱、臉部／延髓無力與自律神經不穩定。

重要特徵：急性進展性無力；反射消失常見；有呼吸衰竭風險；可能出現自律神經不穩定。

診斷方法：臨床檢查搭配神經傳導檢查與腦脊髓液檢查；密切監測呼吸功能。

鑑別診斷：脊髓壓迫、重症肌無力、肉毒桿菌中毒、蜱麻痺、急性肌病。

西醫治療：靜脈免疫球蛋白或血漿置換術，並密切監測呼吸／自律神經功能與復健。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: GBS is a neurologic emergency spectrum distinct from chronic peripheral neuropathy and from myasthenia gravis.

Clinical presentation: Symmetric weakness often begins in legs and ascends; tingling, pain, reduced reflexes, facial/bulbar weakness and autonomic instability can occur.

Key features: acute progressive weakness; areflexia common; respiratory failure possible; autonomic instability possible.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical exam plus nerve-conduction studies and CSF; respiratory function is monitored closely.

Differential diagnosis: spinal cord compression, myasthenia gravis, botulism, tick paralysis, acute myopathy.

Western treatment: IV immunoglobulin or plasma exchange plus respiratory/autonomic monitoring and rehabilitation.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 後期復健須經神經科放行，並注意跌倒與自律神經功能不穩定的風險
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的神經科醫師聯絡確認病情穩定度與復健計畫
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch G Neurology（依據 NINDS 臨床資料整理）

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Acute or evolving GBS is not an acupuncture presentation; later rehabilitation support only once neurology confirms stability
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Rehabilitation-phase treatment requires neurologic clearance and attention to fall/autonomic-instability risk
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's neurologist to confirm clinical stability and rehabilitation plan

acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for GBS was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 馬尾症候群是腰薦神經根受壓迫或功能障礙，造成下肢神經缺損合併大小便／鞍區感覺障礙的高風險組合。
records.summary_en: Cauda equina syndrome is compression or dysfunction of lumbosacral nerve roots causing a high-risk combination of lower-extremity neurologic deficits and bowel/bladder/saddle sensory disturbance.
records.etiology_zh: 大型椎間盤突出、脊椎狹窄、腫瘤、感染／膿瘍、出血或外傷皆可能壓迫馬尾神經。
records.etiology_en: Large disc herniation, spinal stenosis, tumor, infection/abscess, hemorrhage or trauma can compress the cauda equina.
records.western_pathology_zh: 多條腰薦神經根受壓迫，破壞運動、感覺與薦部自律神經傳導路徑，長期壓迫可能造成永久性缺損。
records.western_pathology_en: Compression of multiple lumbosacral roots disrupts motor, sensory and sacral autonomic pathways; prolonged compression can cause permanent deficits.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：馬尾症候群不是一般的坐骨神經痛或下背痛，多數壓迫性病例需要緊急手術評估。

臨床表現：劇烈下背／放射性疼痛、雙側下肢無力／麻木、鞍區感覺喪失、尿滯留／尿失禁與腸道／性功能障礙。

重要特徵：鞍區感覺喪失；新發尿滯留是高辨識度警訊；雙側神經缺損；需即時安排核磁共振與手術評估。

診斷方法：緊急神經學檢查與脊椎核磁共振；依病因加做相關檢驗／影像。

鑑別診斷：單純神經根病變／坐骨神經痛、圓錐症候群、周邊神經病變、功能性症狀、非神經性尿滯留。

西醫治療：壓迫性病因需緊急減壓手術，並針對感染、腫瘤或其他病因治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: This is not ordinary sciatica or low-back pain. Many compressive cases require urgent surgical assessment.

Clinical presentation: Severe low-back/radicular pain, bilateral leg weakness/numbness, saddle anesthesia, urinary retention/incontinence and bowel/sexual dysfunction.

Key features: saddle anesthesia; new urinary retention is high-yield; bilateral neurologic deficits; time-sensitive MRI/surgical evaluation.

Diagnostic approach: Urgent neurologic exam and spinal MRI; cause-specific labs/imaging as needed.

Differential diagnosis: simple radiculopathy/sciatica, conus medullaris syndrome, peripheral neuropathy, functional symptoms, urologic retention without neurologic cause.

Western treatment: Urgent decompression for compressive causes plus treatment of infection, tumor or other etiology.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 對表現為坐骨神經痛的下背痛病人，務必詢問大小便功能與鞍區感覺變化以篩檢紅旗

records.summary_zh: 闌尾炎是闌尾的發炎，通常因管腔阻塞造成，是急性腹痛的常見病因，需要緊急評估。
records.summary_en: Appendicitis is inflammation of the appendix, usually from luminal obstruction, and is a common cause of acute abdominal pain requiring urgent evaluation.
records.etiology_zh: 淋巴組織腫脹、糞石或其他原因造成的管腔阻塞可誘發發炎與感染。
records.etiology_en: Obstruction by lymphoid swelling, fecal material or other causes can initiate inflammation and infection.
records.western_pathology_zh: 管腔阻塞使壓力升高、血流受損並促進細菌增生；可能進展為缺血與穿孔。
records.western_pathology_en: Luminal obstruction increases pressure, impairs blood flow and promotes bacterial overgrowth; ischemia and perforation can follow.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：未治療的闌尾炎可能穿孔，造成膿瘍或腹膜炎。

臨床表現：疼痛常始於臍周並轉移至右下腹，伴隨食慾不振、噁心嘔吐與發燒；表現不典型的情況也存在。

重要特徵：屬急腹症；轉移至右下腹為典型但非絕對；有穿孔風險；影像與檢驗有助診斷。

診斷方法：病史／理學檢查、全血球計數／尿液分析，並依年齡／懷孕／臨床情境選擇超音波或電腦斷層。

鑑別診斷：腸胃炎、腎結石、子宮外孕、骨盆腔發炎疾病、卵巢扭轉、克隆氏病。

西醫治療：多數病人以闌尾切除術為標準治療；部分未複雜化病例可在外科／內科指導下以抗生素治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Untreated appendicitis can perforate, causing abscess or peritonitis.

Clinical presentation: Pain often begins near the umbilicus and migrates to right lower abdomen, with anorexia, nausea/vomiting and fever; atypical presentations occur.

Key features: acute abdomen; migration to RLQ is classic but not universal; perforation risk; imaging/labs support diagnosis.

Diagnostic approach: History/exam, CBC/urinalysis and ultrasound or CT depending on age/pregnancy/context.

Differential diagnosis: gastroenteritis, kidney stone, ectopic pregnancy, PID, ovarian torsion, Crohn disease.

Western treatment: Appendectomy is standard for many patients; selected uncomplicated cases may be managed with antibiotics under surgical/medical guidance.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 急性胰臟炎是胰臟的突發性發炎，病程從自限性疾病到全身性器官衰竭都有可能。
records.summary_en: Acute pancreatitis is sudden inflammation of the pancreas that ranges from self-limited disease to systemic organ failure.
records.etiology_zh: 膽結石與飲酒是常見病因；高三酸甘油脂血症、藥物、處置及其他原因也會造成。
records.etiology_en: Gallstones and alcohol are common causes; hypertriglyceridemia, medications, procedures and other causes also occur.
records.western_pathology_zh: 消化酵素與發炎路徑的提前活化損傷胰臟組織，並可能引發全身性發炎反應。
records.western_pathology_en: Premature activation of digestive enzymes and inflammatory pathways injures pancreatic tissue and can trigger systemic inflammation.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：急性胰臟炎與慢性胰臟炎及非特異性上腹痛不同。

臨床表現：常放射至背部的劇烈上腹痛、噁心嘔吐與壓痛。

重要特徵：急性劇烈上腹痛；脂肪酶有助診斷；膽結石／飲酒為常見病因；器官衰竭定義重症疾病。

診斷方法：典型疼痛合併胰臟酵素升高及／或影像；超音波評估膽結石。

鑑別診斷：消化性潰瘍穿孔、膽絞痛／膽囊炎、心肌梗塞、主動脈疾病、腸道缺血。

西醫治療：住院支持性照護，包括輸液、止痛、營養支持與病因導向治療；膽道阻塞／併發症需處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Acute pancreatitis is distinct from chronic pancreatitis and from nonspecific epigastric pain.

Clinical presentation: Severe upper abdominal pain often radiating to the back, nausea/vomiting and tenderness.

Key features: acute severe epigastric pain; lipase supports diagnosis; gallstones/alcohol common; organ failure defines severe disease.

Diagnostic approach: Typical pain plus elevated pancreatic enzymes and/or imaging; ultrasound evaluates gallstones.

Differential diagnosis: peptic ulcer perforation, biliary colic/cholecystitis, MI, aortic disease, bowel ischemia.

Western treatment: Hospital supportive care with fluids, analgesia, nutrition and cause-specific management; procedures for biliary obstruction/complications as indicated.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 膽結石是膽囊內硬化的沉積物，可能無症狀，也可能造成膽絞痛及膽囊炎、膽管炎或胰臟炎等併發症。
records.summary_en: Gallstones are hardened deposits in the gallbladder that may be asymptomatic or cause biliary colic and complications such as cholecystitis, cholangitis or pancreatitis.
records.etiology_zh: 結石形成反映膽固醇或色素過飽和、膽囊排空不良及其他危險因子。
records.etiology_en: Stone formation reflects cholesterol or pigment supersaturation, gallbladder stasis and other risk factors.
records.western_pathology_zh: 結石間歇性或持續性阻塞膽囊管或總膽管，造成疼痛、發炎或感染。
records.western_pathology_en: A stone intermittently or persistently obstructs the cystic or common bile duct, causing pain, inflammation or infection.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：無症狀膽結石、急性膽囊炎與總膽管結石是不同的臨床狀態；本卡與既有的 `cond.gallbladder_dysfunction`（膽道功能障礙／無結石性膽囊功能異常）是不同實體，非同一疾病——膽結石是結構性問題，膽道功能障礙是動力性問題。

臨床表現：進食後右上腹／上腹痛、噁心嘔吐；發燒或黃疸提示併發症。

重要特徵：多數結石無症狀；膽絞痛與膽囊炎需區分；發燒／黃疸會改變緊急程度；超音波為首選檢查。

診斷方法：超音波搭配實驗室檢查；懷疑總膽管疾病時加做核磁共振膽胰管造影或內視鏡逆行性膽胰管造影等影像。

鑑別診斷：消化性疾病、肝炎、胰臟炎、心肌梗塞、右下肺疾病。

西醫治療：無症狀結石可能不需治療；有症狀者常以膽囊切除術治療；總膽管結石／膽管炎視情況以內視鏡逆行性膽胰管造影處理。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Asymptomatic cholelithiasis, acute cholecystitis and common-bile-duct stones are different clinical states and may need separate cards. This card is distinct from the existing `cond.gallbladder_dysfunction` (biliary dyskinesia / functional gallbladder disorder without stones) — gallstones are a structural problem, biliary dyskinesia is a motility problem; not the same entity.

Clinical presentation: Right upper abdominal/epigastric pain after meals, nausea/vomiting; fever or jaundice suggests complications.

Key features: many stones asymptomatic; biliary colic vs cholecystitis distinction; fever/jaundice change urgency; ultrasound is first-line.

Diagnostic approach: Ultrasound and labs; MRCP/ERCP or other imaging when common duct disease suspected.

Differential diagnosis: peptic disease, hepatitis, pancreatitis, MI, right lower-lung disease.

Western treatment: Asymptomatic stones may need no treatment; symptomatic disease often treated with cholecystectomy; ERCP for duct stones/cholangitis as appropriate.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 腸阻塞是腸道內容物與氣體正常通過受到部分或完全阻礙。
records.summary_en: Intestinal obstruction is partial or complete blockage preventing normal passage of intestinal contents and gas.
records.etiology_zh: 沾黏、疝氣、腫瘤、腸扭轉、腸套疊、狹窄及其他機械性病因會造成阻塞；腸阻塞則有功能性病因。
records.etiology_en: Adhesions, hernias, tumors, volvulus, intussusception, strictures and other mechanical causes occur; ileus has functional causes.
records.western_pathology_zh: 近端腸道液體／氣體堆積造成腸道擴張，妨礙吸收，並可能損害血流造成缺血／穿孔。
records.western_pathology_en: Proximal accumulation of fluid/gas distends bowel, impairs absorption and can compromise blood flow, causing ischemia/perforation.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：機械性阻塞與腸阻塞（麻痺性腸阻塞）或腸道假性阻塞不同，雖然表現可能重疊。

臨床表現：陣發性腹痛、腹脹、嘔吐與無法排氣排便；嚴重度與位置而異。

重要特徵：機械性與功能性阻塞的區分；便秘合併嘔吐／腹脹；絞窄／缺血屬危險；影像檢查為核心。

診斷方法：病史／理學檢查、實驗室檢查及腹部電腦斷層／X光；評估病因與是否有缺血。

鑑別診斷：腸阻塞／假性阻塞、腸胃炎、便秘、闌尾炎、腸繫膜缺血。

西醫治療：腸道休息、靜脈輸液／減壓及病因導向的手術或內視鏡治療；懷疑缺血／穿孔／感染時使用抗生素。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Mechanical obstruction is distinct from ileus or intestinal pseudo-obstruction, though presentations overlap.

Clinical presentation: Crampy abdominal pain, distension, vomiting and inability to pass stool/gas; severity/location varies.

Key features: mechanical vs functional distinction; obstipation + vomiting/distension; strangulation/ischemia dangerous; imaging central.

Diagnostic approach: History/exam, labs and abdominal CT/X-ray; evaluate cause and ischemia.

Differential diagnosis: ileus/pseudo-obstruction, gastroenteritis, constipation, appendicitis, mesenteric ischemia.

Western treatment: Bowel rest, IV fluids/decompression and cause-specific surgery or endoscopic treatment; antibiotics if ischemia/perforation/infection concern.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 肝硬化是晚期慢性肝臟疤痕化，扭曲肝臟結構並損害肝功能與門靜脈血流。
records.summary_en: Cirrhosis is advanced chronic liver scarring that distorts liver architecture and impairs hepatic function and portal blood flow.
records.etiology_zh: 酒精性肝病、慢性 B／C 型肝炎、代謝功能障礙相關脂肪肝病、自體免疫／膽汁淤積性疾病與遺傳性疾病是常見病因。
records.etiology_en: Alcohol-associated liver disease, chronic hepatitis B/C, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, autoimmune/cholestatic and genetic diseases.
records.western_pathology_zh: 反覆肝損傷造成纖維化與結節性再生，導致門脈高壓與肝臟合成／解毒功能喪失。
records.western_pathology_en: Repeated injury causes fibrosis and nodular regeneration, portal hypertension and loss of hepatic synthetic/detoxification function.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：肝硬化是許多慢性肝病的最終共同路徑，與單純脂肪肝或急性肝炎不同。

臨床表現：早期可能無症狀，晚期可出現疲勞、黃疸、腹水／水腫、瘀青／出血、皮膚搔癢、意識混亂與食道靜脈曲張出血。

重要特徵：多為不可逆的晚期纖維化；有門脈高壓；失代償表現包括腹水、靜脈曲張出血、肝性腦病；需定期肝癌篩檢。

診斷方法：實驗室檢查、影像／彈性成像及病因評估；部分病人需切片；評估併發症與肝癌風險。

鑑別診斷：急性肝炎、心衰竭相關充血、非肝硬化性門脈高壓、膽道阻塞。

西醫治療：治療病因、避免肝毒性物質／酒精、處理門脈高壓併發症、定期篩檢並評估肝移植適應症。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對病因與代償狀態。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Cirrhosis is the final common pathway of many chronic liver diseases and is distinct from uncomplicated fatty liver or acute hepatitis.

Clinical presentation: May be silent until advanced; fatigue, jaundice, ascites/edema, bruising/bleeding, pruritus, confusion and variceal bleeding can occur.

Key features: irreversible advanced fibrosis often; portal hypertension; decompensation: ascites, variceal bleed, encephalopathy; HCC surveillance.

Diagnostic approach: Labs, imaging/elastography and cause evaluation; biopsy selected; assess complications and liver cancer risk.

Differential diagnosis: acute hepatitis, heart-failure congestion, noncirrhotic portal hypertension, biliary obstruction.

Western treatment: Treat cause, avoid hepatotoxins/alcohol, manage portal-hypertension complications, surveillance and transplant evaluation for decompensated disease.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review, by cause and compensation status, at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 病毒性肝炎是由肝炎病毒造成的肝臟發炎，主要型別 A、B、C、D、E 在傳染途徑、慢性化風險與治療上各有不同。
records.summary_en: Viral hepatitis is liver inflammation caused by hepatitis viruses, with major types A, B, C, D and E differing in transmission, chronicity and treatment.
records.etiology_zh: 特定肝炎病毒依型別經糞口、血液／體液、垂直傳染或其他途徑傳播。
records.etiology_en: Specific hepatitis viruses transmitted through fecal-oral, blood/body-fluid, perinatal or other routes depending on type.
records.western_pathology_zh: 病毒感染與免疫反應損傷肝細胞；慢性 B／C 型肝炎可進展為纖維化、肝硬化與肝細胞癌。
records.western_pathology_en: Viral infection and immune response injure hepatocytes; chronic HBV/HCV can lead to fibrosis, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：本母概念不應抹除型別特異性；B 型與 C 型肝炎可能慢性化，A 型肝炎通常為急性自限性感染。

臨床表現：可能無症狀，或出現疲勞、噁心、腹部不適、深色尿液與黃疸；慢性病可能長期無症狀。

重要特徵：傳染途徑因型別而異；急慢性區分很重要；B 型／C 型肝炎可能造成肝硬化／肝癌；血清學／病毒核酸檢測依型別而定。

診斷方法：型別特異性血清學與核酸檢測，搭配肝功能評估。

鑑別診斷：藥物引起的肝損傷、自體免疫性肝炎、膽道阻塞、酒精相關肝炎。

西醫治療：依型別而異：多數急性感染以支持性照護為主；慢性 B／C 型肝炎及部分其他情況使用抗病毒藥物；疫苗可預防 A、B 型肝炎。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對型別。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: This parent should not erase type-specific disease. Hepatitis B and C can become chronic; hepatitis A usually causes acute self-limited infection.

Clinical presentation: May be asymptomatic or cause fatigue, nausea, abdominal discomfort, dark urine and jaundice; chronic disease may remain silent.

Key features: type-specific transmission; acute vs chronic distinction; HBV/HCV can cause cirrhosis/HCC; serology/PCR type-specific.

Diagnostic approach: Type-specific serologic and nucleic-acid tests plus liver enzymes/function assessment.

Differential diagnosis: drug-induced liver injury, autoimmune hepatitis, biliary obstruction, alcohol-related hepatitis.

Western treatment: Type-specific: supportive care for many acute infections; antivirals for chronic HBV/HCV and selected other contexts; vaccination prevents A/B.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review, by type, at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 全身性紅斑性狼瘡是一種慢性全身性自體免疫疾病，可影響皮膚、關節、腎臟、神經系統、血液、肺臟、心臟與血管。
records.summary_en: SLE is a chronic systemic autoimmune disease that can affect skin, joints, kidneys, nervous system, blood, lungs, heart and vessels.
records.etiology_zh: 遺傳易感性、荷爾蒙與環境誘發因子共同造成免疫耐受性喪失。
records.etiology_en: Genetic susceptibility, hormones and environmental triggers contribute to loss of immune tolerance.
records.western_pathology_zh: 自體抗體與免疫複合體驅動發炎與器官特異性損傷。
records.western_pathology_en: Autoantibodies and immune complexes drive inflammation and organ-specific injury.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：全身性紅斑性狼瘡具高度異質性，無法僅憑單一抗核抗體陽性來定義。

臨床表現：疲勞、關節炎、光敏感皮疹、口腔潰瘍、血球低下與器官特異性症狀；病程常呈反覆發作／緩解。

重要特徵：多系統自體免疫疾病；抗核抗體敏感度高但特異性低；腎臟／中樞神經系統／血液系統受累會改變嚴重度；治療本身也帶來感染風險。

診斷方法：臨床準則搭配抗核抗體與特異性抗體、補體、全血球計數、尿液分析／蛋白與器官導向檢查。

鑑別診斷：類風濕性關節炎、病毒性疾病、纖維肌痛症、藥物引起的狼瘡、其他結締組織疾病。

西醫治療：奎寧類藥物搭配依器官／嚴重度而定的皮質類固醇／免疫抑制劑／生物製劑治療；防曬與危險因子管理。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: SLE is heterogeneous and cannot be defined by a single positive ANA.

Clinical presentation: Fatigue, arthritis, photosensitive rash, oral ulcers, cytopenias and organ-specific symptoms; course often relapsing/remitting.

Key features: multisystem autoimmune disease; ANA sensitive but nonspecific; renal/CNS/hematologic involvement changes severity; infection risk from treatment.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical criteria plus ANA and specific antibodies, complement, CBC, urinalysis/protein and organ-directed tests.

Differential diagnosis: RA, viral illness, fibromyalgia, drug-induced lupus, other connective-tissue disease.

Western treatment: Hydroxychloroquine and organ/severity-specific corticosteroid/immunosuppressive/biologic therapy; sun protection and risk-factor management.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 重症肌無力是一種自體免疫性神經肌肉接合處疾病，造成波動性、易疲勞性的骨骼肌無力。
records.summary_en: Myasthenia gravis is an autoimmune neuromuscular-junction disorder causing fluctuating fatigable skeletal-muscle weakness.
records.etiology_zh: 自體抗體攻擊乙醯膽鹼受體或相關神經肌肉接合處蛋白；胸腺異常與此病相關。
records.etiology_en: Autoantibodies target acetylcholine-receptor or related neuromuscular-junction proteins; thymic abnormalities are associated.
records.western_pathology_zh: 神經肌肉傳導受損造成使用後加重、休息後改善的無力。
records.western_pathology_en: Impaired neuromuscular transmission causes weakness that worsens with use and improves with rest.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：重症肌無力與中樞神經性無力及格林-巴利症候群不同，感覺功能通常正常。

臨床表現：眼瞼下垂、複視、臉部／延髓無力、構音障礙／吞嚥困難、頸部與近端肢體無力，部分病人有呼吸無力。

重要特徵：易疲勞性無力；常見眼部／延髓症狀；感覺功能保留；重症肌無力危象屬呼吸急症。

診斷方法：抗體檢測、神經電生理檢查與床邊藥理／冰敷測試；胸部影像評估胸腺。

鑑別診斷：格林-巴利症候群、肉毒桿菌中毒、運動神經元疾病、腦幹中風、甲狀腺眼病變。

西醫治療：乙醯膽鹼酯酶抑制劑、免疫治療、部分病人選擇性胸腺切除，危象／惡化時使用靜脈免疫球蛋白或血漿置換。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: MG is distinct from central neurologic weakness and from Guillain-Barré syndrome; sensory function is usually preserved.

Clinical presentation: Ptosis, diplopia, facial/bulbar weakness, dysarthria/dysphagia, neck/proximal weakness and sometimes respiratory weakness.

Key features: fatigable weakness; ocular/bulbar symptoms common; sensation preserved; myasthenic crisis is respiratory emergency.

Diagnostic approach: Antibody tests, electrodiagnostics and bedside pharmacologic/ice tests as appropriate; chest imaging evaluates thymus.

Differential diagnosis: GBS, botulism, motor neuron disease, brainstem stroke, thyroid eye disease.

Western treatment: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitors, immunotherapy, thymectomy in selected patients and IVIG/plasma exchange for crisis/exacerbation.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 女性（40 歲前發病較常見）
男性（60 歲後發病較常見）

risk_factors_en.factor: Female sex (more common onset before age 40)
Male sex (more common onset after age 60)

red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示重症肌無力危象，屬呼吸急症
提示呼吸肌無力惡化
有吸入風險
提示延髓功能嚴重受損
需緊急評估是否進入危象

red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests myasthenic crisis, a respiratory emergency
Suggests worsening respiratory muscle weakness
Aspiration risk
Suggests severe bulbar impairment
Requires urgent evaluation for impending crisis

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不適用於呼吸／延髓症狀惡化；穩定期可作輔助照護
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 須了解可能加重重症肌無力的藥物並與神經科協調；出現呼吸／吞嚥惡化不予治療
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的神經科醫師聯絡確認病情穩定度與用藥情況
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch I Autoimmune/MSK/Derm/Genetic（依據 NINDS 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於重症肌無力的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Do not treat respiratory/bulbar worsening; adjunctive care only in stable-phase patients
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Review medications that can exacerbate MG and coordinate with neurology; do not treat if respiratory/swallowing worsening is present
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's neurologist to confirm clinical stability and medication status
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch I Autoimmune/MSK/Derm/Genetic (compiled from NINDS clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for MG was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 埃勒斯－當洛斯症候群是一組遺傳性結締組織疾病，特徵為關節過動、皮膚過度延展與組織脆弱等不同組合。
records.summary_en: Ehlers-Danlos syndromes (EDS) are inherited connective-tissue disorders characterized by combinations of joint hypermobility, skin hyperextensibility and tissue fragility.
records.etiology_zh: 多數 EDS 亞型由影響膠原蛋白或結締組織路徑的致病性基因變異造成；過動型 EDS 的遺傳基礎則較不明確。
records.etiology_en: Pathogenic variants affecting collagen or connective-tissue pathways cause many EDS subtypes; hypermobile EDS has a different/less defined genetic basis.
records.western_pathology_zh: 異常的結締組織結構降低皮膚、韌帶、血管與器官的張力強度，依亞型而異。
records.western_pathology_en: Abnormal connective-tissue structure reduces tensile strength in skin, ligaments, vessels and organs depending on subtype.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：埃勒斯－當洛斯症候群是一個疾病家族，各亞型在基因與臨床表現上不同；血管型的血管／器官破裂風險明顯高於過動型。

臨床表現：關節過動／脫臼、慢性疼痛、易瘀青、皮膚柔軟／有彈性，並有亞型特異性的血管／器官特徵。

重要特徵：亞型很重要；有關節過動；組織脆弱；血管型屬高風險亞型。

診斷方法：臨床準則搭配家族史，多數亞型可做基因檢測；過動型 EDS 為臨床診斷。

鑑別診斷：過動性譜系障礙、馬凡氏症候群、Loeys-Dietz 症候群、出血性疾病。

西醫治療：預防外傷、物理治療、疼痛管理及亞型特異性心血管／器官監測。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對亞型。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: EDS is a family with genetically/clinically distinct subtypes; vascular EDS has markedly different vascular/organ rupture risk from hypermobile EDS.

Clinical presentation: Joint hypermobility/dislocations, chronic pain, easy bruising, soft/stretchy skin and subtype-specific vascular/organ features.

Key features: subtype matters; joint hypermobility; tissue fragility; vascular EDS is high risk.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical criteria, family history and genetic testing for many subtypes; hypermobile EDS is clinical.

Differential diagnosis: hypermobility spectrum disorder, Marfan syndrome, Loeys-Dietz syndrome, bleeding disorders.

Western treatment: Injury prevention, physical therapy, pain management and subtype-specific cardiovascular/organ surveillance.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review, by subtype, at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 已知致病性膠原蛋白相關基因變異

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發劇烈胸痛或腹痛（血管型 EDS）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示動脈或器官破裂風險
血管型 EDS 有嚴重出血風險
可能提示動脈剝離或破裂

red_flags_zh.finding: 關節脫臼合併神經血管受損徵象
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需評估合併神經血管損傷

red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests arterial/organ rupture risk
Vascular EDS carries serious bleeding risk
May indicate arterial dissection or rupture

red_flags_en.finding: Joint dislocation with signs of neurovascular injury
red_flags_en.rationale: Must evaluate for concurrent neurovascular injury

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可作疼痛輔助照護，須以保守力道進行
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 避免對脆弱組織進行強力手法或深刺；務必先確認亞型與血管風險再決定治療強度
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的遺傳科／心臟科醫師聯絡確認亞型分類與心血管監測進度
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch I Autoimmune/MSK/Derm/Genetic（依據 MedlinePlus Genetics 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於埃勒斯－當洛斯症候群的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Adjunctive pain care using conservative force
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Use conservative force and avoid aggressive manipulation/needling in fragile tissues; subtype/vascular risk must be known before deciding treatment intensity
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's geneticist/cardiologist to confirm subtype classification and cardiovascular surveillance status
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch I Autoimmune/MSK/Derm/Genetic (compiled from MedlinePlus Genetics clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for EDS was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 強迫症的特徵為反覆出現的侵入性強迫思考及／或強迫行為，耗費時間、造成困擾或功能損害。
records.summary_en: OCD is characterized by recurrent intrusive obsessions and/or compulsions that are time-consuming, distressing or impairing.
records.etiology_zh: 遺傳、神經生理與學習機制共同促成。
records.etiology_en: Genetic, neurobiologic and learning factors contribute.
records.western_pathology_zh: 皮質－紋狀體迴路異常及儀式化行為對焦慮的短暫緩解形成強化循環。
records.western_pathology_en: Cortico-striatal circuits and reinforcement of ritualized anxiety-reduction behaviors are implicated.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：強迫症不同於一般的偏好或完美主義，也不同於強迫型人格障礙。

臨床表現：污染恐懼、檢查行為、對稱要求、侵入性禁忌思考及重複性儀式或心理動作。

重要特徵：強迫思考及／或強迫行為、病識感程度不一、儀式短暫緩解焦慮、暴露反應預防為高效治療。

診斷方法：臨床晤談評估時間耗費、困擾程度、功能損害，並鑑別精神病／焦慮／抽動症。

鑑別診斷：廣泛性焦慮症、精神病性疾患、自閉症重複行為、強迫型人格障礙、抽動症。

西醫治療：暴露與反應預防／認知行為治療及 SSRI 為核心治療；重症頑固個案可能需要專科治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: OCD is distinct from ordinary preferences/perfectionism and from obsessive-compulsive personality disorder.

Clinical presentation: Contamination fears, checking, symmetry, intrusive taboo thoughts and repetitive rituals or mental acts can occur.

Key features: obsessions and/or compulsions, insight varies, rituals reduce distress short-term, ERP is high-yield treatment.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical interview assessing time, distress, impairment and differential with psychosis/anxiety/tics.

Differential diagnosis: GAD, psychotic disorders, autism repetitive behavior, OCPD, tic disorders.

Western treatment: Exposure and response prevention/CBT and SSRIs are core treatments; severe refractory illness may need specialty therapies.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_zh.finding: 嚴重自我忽略（無法進食飲水或離開居所）
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示功能嚴重受損
自殺風險須優先處理
可能造成自身傷害
超出強迫症範疇需鑑別

red_flags_en.rationale: Indicates severe functional impairment
Suicide risk requires priority management
Risk of self-harm
Beyond OCD, requires differential diagnosis

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 僅能作為壓力輔助照護
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不得參與或強化強迫性尋求安慰的儀式行為
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的心理治療師／精神科醫師聯絡確認治療進度，不建議病人自行停用相關藥物
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch J Mental/Behavioral（依據 NIMH 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於強迫症的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Adjunctive stress support only
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not participate in or reinforce compulsive reassurance rituals
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's therapist/psychiatrist to confirm treatment status; do not advise the patient to stop related medication
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch J Mental/Behavioral (compiled from NIMH clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for OCD was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 物質使用障礙是一種醫學疾病，特徵為問題性物質使用模式造成功能損害，可能包含儘管有害仍持續使用的強迫性行為。此為總類卡，各物質（酒精、鴉片類、興奮劑等）的臨床識別與處置各有專屬考量。
records.summary_en: Substance use disorders are medical disorders involving problematic patterns of substance use that cause impairment and can include compulsive use despite harm. This is a parent card — each substance (alcohol, opioids, stimulants, etc.) carries its own clinical identity.
records.etiology_zh: 風險反映遺傳、發展階段、創傷／壓力、環境、精神共病及物質暴露的綜合作用。
records.etiology_en: Risk reflects genetics, development, trauma/stress, environment, psychiatric comorbidity and substance exposure.
records.western_pathology_zh: 反覆藥物暴露可改變獎賞、壓力與執行控制系統，強化強迫性使用與復發風險。
records.western_pathology_en: Repeated drug exposure can alter reward, stress and executive-control systems, reinforcing compulsive use and relapse risk.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：臨床識別具物質專屬性與嚴重度分級；中毒、戒斷、過量與物質使用障礙為不同狀態，不可混為一談。此總類卡不取代個別物質的專屬卡片。

臨床表現：失控使用、渴求、危害性使用、部分疾患有耐受性／戒斷、角色功能損害、儘管有害仍持續使用。

重要特徵：屬於醫學疾病而非道德缺陷、具物質專屬性、過量／戒斷可能為急症、常與精神疾病共病。

診斷方法：以臨床物質使用史、功能影響及類 DSM 準則評估；毒物檢測可輔助特定問題但不能單獨診斷 SUD。

鑑別診斷：處方藥物生理依賴（非障礙）、單純急性中毒、原發性情緒／精神病性疾患、譫妄。

西醫治療：實證行為治療、復元支持及特定疾患（如鴉片類使用障礙）的藥物治療，依個人化調整。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須依物質種類、嚴重度及當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: The clinical identity is substance-specific and severity-specific; intoxication, withdrawal, overdose and use disorder are different states. This parent card does not replace substance-specific cards.

Clinical presentation: Loss of control, craving, hazardous use, tolerance/withdrawal in some disorders, role impairment and continued use despite harm.

Key features: medical disorder, not moral failing, substance-specific, overdose/withdrawal may be emergencies, co-occurring mental illness common.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical substance-use history, functional impact and DSM-style criteria; toxicology supports specific questions but does not diagnose SUD by itself.

Differential diagnosis: prescribed physiologic dependence without disorder, acute intoxication only, primary mood/psychotic disorder, delirium.

Western treatment: Evidence-based behavioral therapies, recovery supports and medications for specific disorders such as opioid use disorder; treatment should be individualized.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection depends on substance, severity and the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review.

red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能危及生命
部分戒斷（如酒精、苯二氮平類）可危及生命
危及生命的急症

red_flags_zh.finding: 自殺意念或精神病症狀
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須優先處理安全風險

red_flags_en.rationale: Potentially life-threatening
Some withdrawal states (e.g. alcohol, benzodiazepines) can be life-threatening
Life-threatening emergency
Safety risk requires priority management

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可提供非評判性支持照護並協助轉介，作為輔助而非替代實證治療
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 過量、戒斷急症及精神病症狀不屬於針灸處理範圍
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的成癮醫學／精神科醫師聯絡確認治療進度，不建議病人自行停用戒癮藥物
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch J Mental/Behavioral（依據 NIDA 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於物質使用障礙的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Maintain nonjudgmental screening and referral; acupuncture may be supportive but must not replace evidence-based SUD treatment
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Overdose, dangerous withdrawal and psychosis are outside acupuncture scope
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's addiction-medicine/psychiatric clinician to confirm treatment status; do not advise the patient to stop medication-assisted treatment
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch J Mental/Behavioral (compiled from NIDA clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for SUD was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

sources: NIDA — Drugs, Brains, and Behavior: The Science of Addiction: https://nida.nih.gov/publications/drugs-brains-behavior-science-addiction

records.summary_zh: 異常子宮出血是指子宮出血在時機、規律性、持續時間或量方面異常，為一組須進一步分類病因的症候群，而非單一疾病。
records.summary_en: Abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) is uterine bleeding abnormal in timing, regularity, duration or amount and is a syndrome requiring cause classification.
records.etiology_zh: 須區分子宮結構性病因、排卵／內分泌功能障礙、凝血功能異常、藥物及妊娠相關病因。
records.etiology_en: Structural uterine causes, ovulatory/endocrine dysfunction, bleeding disorders, medications and pregnancy-related causes must be distinguished.
records.western_pathology_zh: 機轉依病因而異：子宮內膜不穩定／無排卵、結構性出血面、凝血功能障礙或藥物作用。
records.western_pathology_en: Mechanism depends on cause: endometrial instability/anovulation, structural bleeding surface, coagulation disorder or medication effects.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：AUB 並非單一病因，不應直接等同於子宮肌瘤、無排卵或中醫「崩漏」。此卡為症候群層級的導覽卡，須依 PALM-COEIN 等架構逐一排除病因。

臨床表現：經血過多、經期延長、不規則／經間出血，可能合併缺鐵性貧血症狀。

重要特徵：屬於症候群而非單一疾病、須考慮妊娠可能、PALM-COEIN 式病因邏輯有助分類、貧血為常見後果。

診斷方法：視情況進行懷孕檢測、全血球計數、病史與理學檢查，並依病因導向進行內分泌／凝血功能檢測與骨盆腔影像。

鑑別診斷：妊娠／子宮外孕、子宮肌瘤／息肉、子宮內膜惡性病變、凝血功能障礙、內分泌／無排卵性出血。

西醫治療：依病因與嚴重度選擇荷爾蒙／非荷爾蒙藥物治療、補鐵，及視情況進行相關處置或手術。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: AUB is not one etiology and should not be equated directly with fibroids, anovulation or the TCM disease 崩漏. This is a syndrome-level navigational card requiring cause classification (e.g. PALM-COEIN framework).

Clinical presentation: Heavy menstrual bleeding, prolonged bleeding, irregular/intermenstrual bleeding and symptoms of iron deficiency/anemia.

Key features: syndrome not single disease, pregnancy must be considered, PALM-COEIN-style cause logic may be useful, anemia consequence.

Diagnostic approach: Pregnancy testing where applicable, CBC, history/exam and cause-directed endocrine/coagulation testing and pelvic imaging/endometrial assessment.

Differential diagnosis: pregnancy/ectopic, fibroids/polyps, endometrial malignancy, coagulopathy, endocrine/anovulatory bleeding.

Western treatment: Cause- and severity-specific hormonal/nonhormonal medication, iron replacement and procedures/surgery as indicated.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 多囊性卵巢症候群等無排卵性疾患

red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能危及生命

red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示嚴重貧血或血流動力學不穩定

red_flags_zh.rationale: 須優先排除妊娠相關急症

red_flags_zh.finding: 嚴重骨盆腔疼痛或血流動力學不穩定
red_flags_zh.rationale: 屬於婦科急症

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不得將嚴重出血視為常規證型處理，須先量化出血量、篩檢妊娠與貧血
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 任何符合紅旗條件的出血須優先轉診，不應延誤
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的婦產科醫師聯絡確認病因分類與治療進度
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch K Reproductive/Gyne/Urology（依據 NICHD 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於異常子宮出血的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Do not treat severe bleeding as a routine pattern; quantify bleeding, screen pregnancy/anemia first
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Any bleeding meeting red-flag criteria requires priority referral, not delay
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's OB/GYN to confirm cause classification and treatment progress
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch K Reproductive/Gyne/Urology (compiled from NICHD clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for AUB was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 子宮外孕是胚胎著床於子宮腔外（最常見於輸卵管），有破裂與危及生命之腹腔內出血風險。
records.summary_en: Ectopic pregnancy is implantation of a pregnancy outside the main uterine cavity, most commonly in a fallopian tube, with risk of rupture and life-threatening internal bleeding.
records.etiology_zh: 輸卵管損傷或功能異常，以及既往子宮外孕、手術史、骨盆腔感染／性病、子宮內膜異位症與生育治療等因子皆可能提高風險，但也可能無任何危險因子。
records.etiology_en: Tubal damage/dysfunction and risk factors such as prior ectopic, surgery, PID/STIs, endometriosis and fertility treatment can increase risk, though no risk factor may be present.
records.western_pathology_zh: 生長中的異位妊娠組織可侵入並使著床部位破裂，造成腹腔內出血與休克。
records.western_pathology_en: Growing ectopic tissue can invade and rupture the implantation site, causing intraperitoneal hemorrhage and shock.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：子宮外孕無法正常發育，屬於時間敏感的妊娠急症，與流產為不同狀態。

臨床表現：經期延遲／妊娠症狀、骨盆腔／腹部疼痛與陰道出血；破裂時可能出現肩痛、暈眩或暈厥。

重要特徵：妊娠位置異常、破裂會造成內出血、hCG 與超音波為核心檢查、育齡期急性腹痛須先確認妊娠狀態。

診斷方法：懷孕檢測、連續 hCG 追蹤與經陰道超音波；骨盆腔檢查提供輔助資訊。

鑑別診斷：流產、卵巢扭轉／卵巢囊腫、骨盆腔發炎疾病、闌尾炎、腎結石。

西醫治療：符合條件之未破裂個案可使用 methotrexate 或手術；已破裂之子宮外孕須緊急手術處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Ectopic pregnancy cannot progress normally and is a time-sensitive pregnancy emergency distinct from miscarriage.

Clinical presentation: Missed period/pregnancy symptoms, pelvic/abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding; rupture may cause shoulder pain, dizziness or syncope.

Key features: pregnancy outside uterus, rupture causes internal bleeding, hCG + ultrasound central, pregnancy status is essential in reproductive-age acute pain.

Diagnostic approach: Pregnancy testing, serial hCG and transvaginal ultrasound; pelvic exam contributes.

Differential diagnosis: miscarriage, ovarian torsion/cyst, PID, appendicitis, kidney stone.

Western treatment: Methotrexate for selected unruptured cases or surgery; ruptured ectopic requires emergency surgical management.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 骨盆腔發炎疾病／性病史

red_flags_zh.finding: 劇烈腹部／骨盆腔疼痛合併疑似懷孕
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須排除破裂性子宮外孕
提示腹腔內出血刺激橫膈
提示血流動力學不穩定

red_flags_zh.finding: 大量陰道出血或休克徵象
red_flags_zh.rationale: 危及生命

red_flags_en.finding: Severe abdominal/pelvic pain with possible pregnancy
red_flags_en.rationale: Must exclude ruptured ectopic pregnancy
Suggests intraperitoneal bleeding irritating the diaphragm
Suggests hemodynamic instability

red_flags_en.finding: Heavy vaginal bleeding or signs of shock
red_flags_en.rationale: Life-threatening

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不適用——不得以一般痛經或腹痛處理疑似子宮外孕
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 任何育齡期婦女疑似懷孕合併劇痛，須優先確認妊娠狀態並轉診
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 立即轉診婦產科／急診，不進行針灸延誤處置
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch K Reproductive/Gyne/Urology（依據 MedlinePlus 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 此為急症，針灸角色僅限於緊急轉診之後的恢復期輔助照護

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not applicable — never treat possible ectopic pregnancy as ordinary dysmenorrhea or abdominal pain
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Any reproductive-age patient with possible pregnancy and severe pain requires pregnancy status confirmation and referral first
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Immediate referral to OB/GYN or emergency care; do not delay with acupuncture
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch K Reproductive/Gyne/Urology (compiled from MedlinePlus clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: This is a medical emergency; acupuncture's role is limited to recovery-phase support after emergency referral

records.summary_zh: 子癲前症是懷孕 20 週後出現、合併母體器官系統受累的妊娠特異性高血壓疾患；子癲症則是合併癲癇發作的子癲前症。
records.summary_en: Preeclampsia is a pregnancy-specific hypertensive disorder arising after 20 weeks with maternal organ-system involvement; eclampsia is preeclampsia with seizures.
records.etiology_zh: 確切病因尚未完全清楚；異常胎盤形成與血管內皮功能障礙為主要致病模型。
records.etiology_en: Cause is incompletely understood; abnormal placentation and vascular/endothelial dysfunction are central models.
records.western_pathology_zh: 胎盤與母體血管內皮功能障礙造成高血壓、器官缺血／損傷與胎盤功能不足。
records.western_pathology_en: Placental and maternal endothelial dysfunction produces hypertension, organ ischemia/injury and fetal placental insufficiency.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：妊娠高血壓、子癲前症、HELLP 症候群與子癲症為一組相關但不同的臨床狀態，此卡涵蓋子癲前症／子癲症光譜，嚴重個案（HELLP、子癲症）可視為併發狀態。

臨床表現：高血壓可能無症狀；嚴重個案可出現劇烈頭痛、視覺症狀、右上腹／上腹痛、呼吸困難與水腫；子癲症出現癲癇發作。

重要特徵：懷孕 20 週後發生、血壓合併器官受累、HELLP 與子癲症屬嚴重狀態、可延續至產後。

診斷方法：反覆血壓量測、尿蛋白檢測，及血小板、肝腎功能等血液檢查；視情況進行胎兒評估。

鑑別診斷：慢性／妊娠性高血壓、偏頭痛、血栓性血小板減少性紫斑症、妊娠急性脂肪肝、癲癇疾患。

西醫治療：母體穩定、嚴重高血壓使用降壓藥、硫酸鎂預防／治療癲癇發作，並依妊娠週數與嚴重度決定分娩時機。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, HELLP syndrome and eclampsia are related but distinct clinical states; this card covers the preeclampsia/eclampsia spectrum, with severe states (HELLP, eclampsia) treated as complication states.

Clinical presentation: Hypertension may be asymptomatic; severe headache, visual symptoms, RUQ/epigastric pain, dyspnea and swelling can occur; eclampsia causes seizures.

Key features: after 20 weeks, BP + organ involvement, HELLP and eclampsia severe states, can persist/postpartum.

Diagnostic approach: Repeated BP measurement, urine protein and blood tests for platelets, liver and kidney function; fetal assessment as appropriate.

Differential diagnosis: chronic/gestational hypertension, migraine, TTP, acute fatty liver of pregnancy, seizure disorder.

Western treatment: Maternal stabilization, antihypertensives for severe BP, magnesium sulfate for seizure prevention/treatment and delivery timing based on gestational age/severity.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 慢性高血壓或糖尿病病史

red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示嚴重子癲前症
可能提示 HELLP 症候群
可能提示肺水腫等嚴重併發症
為子癲症，危及母嬰生命

red_flags_zh.finding: 嚴重高血壓或胎動減少
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須立即評估母嬰安全

red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests severe preeclampsia
May indicate HELLP syndrome
May indicate pulmonary edema or other severe complications
Eclampsia, life-threatening to mother and fetus

red_flags_en.finding: Severe hypertension or decreased fetal movement
red_flags_en.rationale: Requires immediate assessment of maternal-fetal safety

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 出現嚴重徵象時不適用常規針灸照護
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 懷孕本身即須謹慎選穴與手法；嚴重子癲前症／子癲症須由產科團隊主導處置
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的產科醫師聯絡協調照護，絕不可延誤緊急產科評估
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch K Reproductive/Gyne/Urology（依據 NICHD 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 此為妊娠急症光譜，針灸角色須嚴格限縮於產科團隊協調之下

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not a condition for routine acupuncture management when severe features are present
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Pregnancy itself requires cautious point selection and technique; severe preeclampsia/eclampsia must be led by the obstetric team
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Coordinate with the patient's obstetric team; never delay emergency obstetric evaluation
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch K Reproductive/Gyne/Urology (compiled from NICHD clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: This spans a pregnancy-emergency spectrum; acupuncture's role must be strictly subordinate to obstetric team coordination

records.summary_zh: 急性閉角型青光眼是房水外流突然受阻，造成眼內壓急遽升高並威脅視力的眼科急症。
records.summary_en: Acute angle-closure glaucoma is sudden obstruction of aqueous outflow causing a rapid rise in intraocular pressure and threat to vision.
records.etiology_zh: 解剖上房角較窄者易感；瞳孔散大或其他誘發因子可促發房角關閉。
records.etiology_en: Anatomically narrow angles predispose; pupillary dilation or other triggers can precipitate closure.
records.western_pathology_zh: 虹膜阻塞小樑網引流，使眼內壓急速上升並損傷視神經與眼部結構。
records.western_pathology_en: Iris blocks trabecular drainage, rapidly increasing intraocular pressure and injuring optic nerve/ocular structures.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：屬於眼科急症，與慢性隅角開放性青光眼為不同狀態。

臨床表現：劇烈眼痛、紅眼、視力模糊／光暈、頭痛、噁心嘔吐。

重要特徵：眼科急症、眼內壓急速上升、疼痛性紅眼、視力可能快速喪失。

診斷方法：緊急眼科檢查，測量眼內壓並評估房角與視神經。

鑑別診斷：葡萄膜炎、角膜炎、偏頭痛、結膜炎、眼眶蜂窩性組織炎。

西醫治療：快速降眼壓藥物，隨後接受雷射虹膜切開術等眼科處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: It is a medical emergency and distinct from chronic open-angle glaucoma.

Clinical presentation: Severe eye pain, red eye, blurred vision/halos, headache, nausea/vomiting.

Key features: ocular emergency, rapid IOP rise, painful red eye, vision loss can occur quickly.

Diagnostic approach: Urgent eye exam with intraocular pressure and angle/optic evaluation.

Differential diagnosis: uveitis, keratitis, migraine, conjunctivitis, orbital cellulitis.

Western treatment: Rapid pressure-lowering medication followed by laser iridotomy and other ophthalmic treatment.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_zh.finding: 劇烈眼痛合併紅眼、噁心與視力模糊
red_flags_zh.rationale: 為眼科急症，延誤可能造成永久性視力喪失

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden intense eye pain with red eye, nausea and blurred vision
red_flags_en.rationale: Ocular emergency; delay can cause permanent vision loss

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不適用——不得於眼周針刺或延誤轉診
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 任何疑似急性閉角型青光眼徵象須立即轉診，不進行眼周治療
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 立即轉診眼科／急診
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies（依據 NEI 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 此為眼科急症，針灸角色僅限於緊急轉診之後的恢復期輔助照護

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not applicable — do not needle around the eye or delay referral when acute angle closure is possible
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Any suspected acute angle-closure glaucoma requires immediate referral, not periocular treatment
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Immediate referral to ophthalmology/emergency care
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies (compiled from NEI clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: This is an ocular emergency; acupuncture's role is limited to recovery-phase support after emergency referral

records.summary_zh: 視網膜剝離是視網膜自其正常位置分離的視力威脅急症。
records.summary_en: Retinal detachment occurs when the retina separates from its normal position and is a vision-threatening emergency.
records.etiology_zh: 視網膜裂孔、糖尿病牽引、發炎／滲出性疾病、外傷及既往眼科手術皆可能造成不同類型的視網膜剝離。
records.etiology_en: Retinal tears, diabetic traction, inflammatory/exudative disease, trauma and prior eye surgery can cause different types.
records.western_pathology_zh: 神經感覺層視網膜自下方支持組織分離，干擾光受器功能並可能造成永久性視力喪失。
records.western_pathology_en: Separation of neurosensory retina from underlying support disrupts photoreceptor function and can cause permanent vision loss.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：主要類型包括裂孔性、牽引性與滲出性；玻璃體後脫離為風險因子／鑑別診斷，非相同疾病。

臨床表現：突發新發飛蚊症、閃光感與視野出現陰影／簾幕感；黃斑部剝離時中心視力可能下降。

重要特徵：醫療急症、飛蚊症＋閃光＋簾幕感為高指標性表現、須散瞳檢查、早期手術／雷射可保護視力。

診斷方法：散瞳眼底檢查；必要時輔以眼部超音波或 OCT。

鑑別診斷：玻璃體後脫離、眼性偏頭痛、玻璃體出血、視網膜血管阻塞。

西醫治療：依類型選擇雷射／冷凍治療裂孔，或氣體視網膜固定術、鞏膜扣壓術、玻璃體切除術等處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Major types are rhegmatogenous, tractional and exudative; posterior vitreous detachment is a risk/differential but not the same condition.

Clinical presentation: Sudden new floaters, flashes of light and a shadow/curtain over vision; central acuity may decline as macula detaches.

Key features: medical emergency, floaters + flashes + curtain high-yield, dilated exam, early surgery/laser protects vision.

Diagnostic approach: Dilated retinal exam; ocular ultrasound/OCT when needed.

Differential diagnosis: posterior vitreous detachment, ocular migraine, vitreous hemorrhage, retinal vascular occlusion.

Western treatment: Laser/cryo for tears and procedures such as pneumatic retinopexy, scleral buckle or vitrectomy for detachment depending type.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 既往眼科手術或外傷史

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發性飛蚊症、閃光或視野簾幕感
red_flags_zh.rationale: 延誤處置可能造成永久性視力喪失

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden floaters, flashes or visual curtain/shadow
red_flags_en.rationale: Delayed treatment can cause permanent vision loss

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不適用——急性症狀須交由眼科處理
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 在排除急症病因之前避免眼周治療
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 立即轉診眼科
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies（依據 NEI 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 此為眼科急症，針灸角色僅限於緊急轉診之後的恢復期輔助照護

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not applicable — acute symptoms require ophthalmology, not acupuncture
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Avoid ocular-area treatment until emergency causes excluded
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Immediate referral to ophthalmology
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies (compiled from NEI clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: This is an ocular emergency; acupuncture's role is limited to recovery-phase support after emergency referral

records.name_zh: 突發性感音神經性聽力損失
records.summary_zh: 突發性感音神經性聽力損失是數小時至數天內快速出現、原因不明之內耳聽力損失，多為單側，屬於醫療急症。
records.summary_en: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSHL) is rapid unexplained inner-ear hearing loss developing over hours to a few days, often unilateral, and is a medical emergency.
records.etiology_zh: 多數為特發性；感染、自體免疫疾病、循環問題、神經疾病、外傷或耳毒性藥物皆可能為病因。
records.etiology_en: Most cases are idiopathic; infections, autoimmune disease, circulation problems, neurologic disease, trauma or ototoxic drugs can be causes.
records.western_pathology_zh: 耳蝸／內耳感覺路徑急性功能障礙，造成快速的感音神經性閾值損失。
records.western_pathology_en: Acute dysfunction of cochlear/inner-ear sensory pathways produces rapid sensorineural threshold loss.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：屬於時間敏感的醫療急症，須立即與耳垢／積液造成的傳導性聽力損失及慢性聽力損失區分；與慢性耳鳴／感音神經性聽損（見 cond.hearing_loss）為不同臨床狀態，不應以慢性耳鳴常規處置延誤評估。

臨床表現：常於睡醒時發現的單側突發聽力損失，可合併耳鳴、耳脹感及／或暈眩。

重要特徵：時間敏感急症、多為單側、應於數天內完成聽力檢測、常考慮類固醇治療。

診斷方法：先排除傳導性聽力損失，並進行純音聽力檢測；視情況加做影像／血液檢查尋找病因。

鑑別診斷：耳垢阻塞、中耳炎、梅尼爾氏症、聽神經瘤、腦中風。

西醫治療：適當個案常使用類固醇治療；找到病因時依病因處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: It must be distinguished promptly from conductive loss due to cerumen/fluid and from chronic hearing loss; this is a distinct clinical state from the chronic tinnitus/sensorineural hearing loss picture in cond.hearing_loss and should not be managed with routine chronic-tinnitus care that delays evaluation.

Clinical presentation: Sudden unilateral hearing loss, sometimes noticed on waking, with tinnitus, ear fullness and/or dizziness.

Key features: time-sensitive emergency, often unilateral, audiometry within days, steroids commonly considered.

Diagnostic approach: Rule out conductive loss and obtain pure-tone audiometry; additional imaging/labs seek underlying cause.

Differential diagnosis: cerumen impaction, otitis media, Ménière disease, vestibular schwannoma, stroke.

Western treatment: Corticosteroid treatment is commonly used when appropriate; cause-specific management if identified.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即醫療／耳鼻喉科評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 屬於時間敏感急症，及早評估與治療影響預後
提示中樞／血管性病因

red_flags_en.rationale: Time-sensitive emergency; early evaluation and treatment affect outcome
Raises central/vascular concern

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不得將突發性聽力損失標記為慢性耳鳴耳聾而延誤轉診
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 立即轉診耳鼻喉科／急診
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies（依據 NIDCD 臨床資料整理）

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not applicable for initial management — do not label sudden hearing loss as chronic tinnitus/hearing loss and begin routine care first
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Time-to-evaluation matters; do not delay referral
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Immediate referral to ENT/emergency care

records.summary_zh: 急性細菌性鼻竇炎是通常繼發於病毒性上呼吸道感染之副鼻竇細菌性感染／發炎，須與病毒性鼻竇炎區分。
records.summary_en: Acute bacterial rhinosinusitis is bacterial infection/inflammation of the paranasal sinuses, usually following a viral URI, and must be distinguished from viral rhinosinusitis.
records.etiology_zh: 常見細菌病原體於病毒性上呼吸道感染後或其他易感因子下，感染阻塞發炎的鼻竇。
records.etiology_en: Common bacterial pathogens infect obstructed/inflamed sinuses after viral URI or other predisposition.
records.western_pathology_zh: 黏膜水腫阻塞引流，使細菌得以感染並造成壓力與發炎。
records.western_pathology_en: Mucosal edema obstructs drainage, allowing bacterial infection and pressure/inflammation.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：與慢性鼻竇炎為不同的臨床狀態（此為急性、通常繼發於病毒感染），也與單純病毒性鼻竇炎不同；單純膿性分泌物不足以證實細菌感染，須依病程與惡化型態判斷。

臨床表現：鼻塞／鼻分泌物、顏面疼痛／壓迫感、嗅覺減退，可能合併發燒。

重要特徵：病毒與細菌鑑別重要、持續／嚴重／雙重惡化型態具意義、眼眶／顱內併發症少見但嚴重、抗生素使用須有選擇性。

診斷方法：多以臨床診斷為主；影像保留於併發症或替代診斷之評估。

鑑別診斷：病毒性上呼吸道感染、過敏性鼻炎、牙源性感染、偏頭痛、慢性鼻竇炎。

西醫治療：症狀治療，並依細菌感染條件／嚴重度選擇性使用抗生素；併發症須緊急處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Distinct from chronic sinusitis (this is acute, usually secondary to viral infection) and from simple viral rhinosinusitis; purulent discharge alone does not prove bacterial infection — duration/severity/worsening pattern guides diagnosis.

Clinical presentation: Nasal obstruction/discharge, facial pain/pressure, reduced smell and sometimes fever.

Key features: viral vs bacterial distinction, persistent/severe/double-worsening patterns matter, orbital/intracranial complications rare but serious, antibiotics selective.

Diagnostic approach: Usually clinical; imaging reserved for complications/alternative diagnosis.

Differential diagnosis: viral URI, allergic rhinitis, dental infection, migraine, chronic rhinosinusitis.

Western treatment: Symptomatic care and antibiotics when bacterial criteria/severity indicate; treat complications urgently.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 眼眶周圍腫脹、視力改變或嚴重頭痛須先排除併發症
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 若使用抗生素治療，與病人的處方醫師聯絡確認治療進度

acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Periorbital swelling, vision change or severe headache require complication evaluation first

records.summary_zh: 中耳炎是中耳的發炎／感染；急性中耳炎與中耳積水為不同狀態。
records.summary_en: Otitis media is inflammation/infection of the middle ear; acute otitis media and otitis media with effusion are distinct.
records.etiology_zh: 病毒性上呼吸道感染後常出現耳咽管功能障礙，使中耳積液並可能合併細菌／病毒感染，兒童尤其常見。
records.etiology_en: Eustachian-tube dysfunction after viral URI can permit middle-ear fluid and bacterial/viral infection, especially in children.
records.western_pathology_zh: 中耳壓力與積液合併發炎，造成耳痛與傳導性聽力改變。
records.western_pathology_en: Middle-ear pressure/fluid and inflammation cause pain and conductive hearing changes.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：中耳疾病與外耳炎及突發性感音神經性聽力損失為不同狀態。

臨床表現：耳痛、發燒、易怒、聽力減退及鼓膜變化；積水可在無急性感染下持續存在。

重要特徵：急性中耳炎與積水須區分、耳鏡檢查為核心、聽力變化多為傳導性、乳突炎併發症少見但嚴重。

診斷方法：耳鏡檢查確認中耳積液／發炎；持續積水或聽力損失須加做聽力檢測。

鑑別診斷：外耳炎、耳垢阻塞、顳顎關節／牙源性疼痛、突發性感音神經性聽力損失、乳突炎。

西醫治療：依年齡、嚴重度與診斷確定性選擇止痛與觀察或抗生素治療；反覆／持續積水個案可考慮中耳通氣管置入。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Middle-ear disease is distinct from otitis externa and sudden sensorineural hearing loss.

Clinical presentation: Ear pain, fever, irritability, reduced hearing and tympanic-membrane changes; effusion can persist without acute infection.

Key features: AOM vs effusion, otoscopy central, hearing changes usually conductive, mastoid complications uncommon but serious.

Diagnostic approach: Otoscopy showing middle-ear effusion/inflammation; hearing testing for persistent effusion/loss.

Differential diagnosis: otitis externa, cerumen, TMJ/dental pain, SSHL, mastoiditis.

Western treatment: Analgesia and observation or antibiotics based on age/severity/diagnostic certainty; tubes for selected recurrent/persistent disease.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.
