records.summary_zh: COVID-19 是 SARS-CoV-2 感染，病程範圍從無症狀感染到嚴重多重器官疾病及急性期後的長新冠。
records.summary_en: COVID-19 is infection caused by SARS-CoV-2, ranging from asymptomatic infection to critical multisystem disease and post-acute Long COVID.
records.etiology_zh: SARS-CoV-2 感染，主要透過呼吸道飛沫傳播。
records.etiology_en: SARS-CoV-2 infection transmitted primarily through respiratory particles.
records.western_pathology_zh: 病毒感染與宿主免疫反應影響呼吸道及其他器官系統；重症可造成低血氧性肺炎與血栓發炎併發症。
records.western_pathology_en: Viral infection and host immune response affect respiratory and other organ systems; severe disease can cause hypoxemic pneumonia and thromboinflammatory complications.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：與流感症狀重疊，僅憑症狀無法可靠區分兩者；急性感染與「長新冠」（見 cond.post_covid）為不同臨床階段，不應混為一談。

臨床表現：發燒畏寒、咳嗽、呼吸困難、疲勞、喉嚨痛、鼻塞、肌肉痠痛、頭痛、腸胃症狀及味嗅覺改變。

重要特徵：病毒檢測可確診、嚴重度範圍廣、符合條件之高風險門診病人可儘早使用抗病毒藥物、長新冠屬獨立的急性期後狀態。

診斷方法：核酸／抗原病毒檢測，並評估嚴重度。

鑑別診斷：流感、普通感冒、肺炎、肺栓塞、氣喘／慢性阻塞性肺病急性惡化。

西醫治療：低風險輕症以支持性療法為主；符合條件之高風險門診病人使用限時抗病毒藥物，重症依醫院準則處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: COVID-19 and influenza share symptoms but are caused by different viruses and cannot be reliably distinguished by symptoms alone; acute infection and 'Long COVID' (see cond.post_covid) are distinct clinical stages and should not be conflated.

Clinical presentation: Fever/chills, cough, dyspnea, fatigue, sore throat, congestion, myalgias, headache, GI symptoms and taste/smell change may occur.

Key features: viral testing confirms, severity spectrum broad, early outpatient antivirals for eligible high-risk patients, Long COVID is separate post-acute condition.

Diagnostic approach: NAAT/PCR or antigen viral testing plus severity evaluation.

Differential diagnosis: influenza, common cold, pneumonia, PE, asthma/COPD exacerbation.

Western treatment: Supportive care for low-risk mild disease; time-limited antiviral options for high-risk outpatients and hospital protocols for severe disease.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 急性期不建議常規面對面針灸治療活動性傳染病
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 若使用抗病毒藥物治療，與病人的處方醫師聯絡確認治療進度

records.summary_zh: 結核病是結核分枝桿菌複合群造成的活動性疾病，最常見於肺部，但可能侵犯幾乎任何器官。
records.summary_en: Tuberculosis disease is active illness caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex, most often pulmonary but potentially affecting nearly any organ.
records.etiology_zh: 結核分枝桿菌經由空氣傳播；免疫抑制與特定共病會提高由潛伏感染進展為活動性疾病的機率。
records.etiology_en: Airborne transmission of M. tuberculosis; progression from latent infection is more likely with immunosuppression and certain comorbidities.
records.western_pathology_zh: 分枝桿菌逃避／突破免疫圍堵，增殖並造成肉芽腫性組織損傷；肺部疾病可透過空氣傳播病原體。
records.western_pathology_en: Mycobacteria evade/overcome immune containment, multiply and create granulomatous tissue injury; pulmonary disease can transmit organisms through air.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：活動性結核病與潛伏結核感染為不同狀態——潛伏感染無症狀且不具傳染性，不應與活動性疾病混淆。

臨床表現：肺結核可出現持續 3 週以上的咳嗽、胸痛、痰／咳血、疲勞、體重減輕、發燒與夜間盜汗。

重要特徵：活動性與潛伏感染須區分、具空氣傳播感染管制意涵、屬於通報疾病、須以痰液／培養／分子檢測評估。

診斷方法：結核血液／皮膚檢測顯示感染但不能單獨診斷活動性疾病；須輔以胸部影像及痰液抹片／培養／分子檢測。

鑑別診斷：肺炎、肺癌、黴菌感染、類肉瘤病、潛伏結核感染。

西醫治療：依公共衛生／臨床指引使用多重抗生素治療；服藥遵從性與抗藥性檢測至為關鍵。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Active TB disease is distinct from latent/inactive TB infection: latent infection causes no symptoms and is not contagious.

Clinical presentation: Pulmonary TB can cause cough ≥3 weeks, chest pain, sputum/hemoptysis, fatigue, weight loss, fever and night sweats.

Key features: active vs latent distinction, airborne infection-control implications, reportable disease, sputum/culture/molecular testing.

Diagnostic approach: TB blood/skin test indicates infection but does not alone diagnose active disease; chest imaging and sputum smear/culture/molecular tests evaluate disease.

Differential diagnosis: pneumonia, lung cancer, fungal infection, sarcoidosis, latent TB.

Western treatment: Multi-drug antimicrobial therapy under public-health/clinical guidance; adherence and resistance testing are critical.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 萊姆病是由帶原黑腿蜱傳播的細菌性感染；未治療的感染可侵犯皮膚、關節、心臟與神經系統。
records.summary_en: Lyme disease is a bacterial infection transmitted by infected blacklegged ticks; untreated infection can involve skin, joints, heart and nervous system.
records.etiology_zh: 美國主要病原體為伯氏疏螺旋體，少數為 B. mayonii，由硬蜱屬（Ixodes）蜱傳播。
records.etiology_en: In the U.S., mainly Borrelia burgdorferi and rarely B. mayonii transmitted by Ixodes ticks.
records.western_pathology_zh: 局部感染可經血液／組織擴散，引發神經、心臟或關節表現。
records.western_pathology_en: Local infection can disseminate through blood/tissues and trigger neurologic, cardiac or joint manifestations.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：在適當暴露情境下出現遊走性紅斑可作為臨床診斷依據；單獨的非特異性慢性症狀不足以確立萊姆病診斷。

臨床表現：早期出現發燒、頭痛、疲勞與遊走性紅斑；後期可出現顏面麻痺、腦膜炎／神經根性疼痛、心臟傳導阻滯或關節炎。

重要特徵：蜱媒傳播、遊走性紅斑具高度診斷價值、指定情境下採兩步驟血清學檢測、可能出現神經／心臟併發症。

診斷方法：典型遊走性紅斑可臨床診斷；否則採 CDC 建議之兩步驟血清學檢測並依器官表現評估。

鑑別診斷：造成紅疹的蜂窩性組織炎／癬、其他病因之顏面神經麻痺、病毒性症候群、類風濕性關節炎、其他蜱媒疾病。

西醫治療：依臨床表現選擇適當口服或靜脈抗生素；早期治療可預防多數併發症。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Erythema migrans in an appropriate exposure context can be diagnostic; nonspecific chronic symptoms alone do not establish Lyme disease.

Clinical presentation: Fever, headache, fatigue and erythema migrans early; later facial palsy, meningitis/radicular pain, carditis/heart block or arthritis.

Key features: tick-borne, erythema migrans high-yield, two-step serology for indicated testing, neurologic/cardiac complications.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical diagnosis for classic EM; otherwise CDC-recommended two-step serology plus organ-specific evaluation.

Differential diagnosis: cellulitis/tinea for rash, Bell palsy other causes, viral syndrome, RA, other tick-borne disease.

Western treatment: Appropriate oral or IV antibiotics based on manifestation; early treatment prevents many complications.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.name_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒感染
records.summary_zh: HIV 是攻擊免疫系統的慢性病毒感染；未治療可能進展為愛滋病，而有效抗反轉錄病毒治療可抑制病毒複製並維持健康。
records.summary_en: HIV is a chronic viral infection that attacks the immune system; untreated infection can progress to AIDS, while effective antiretroviral therapy can suppress viral replication and preserve health.
records.etiology_zh: 透過特定體液傳播，包括性行為、血液及垂直傳染。
records.etiology_en: Transmission occurs through specific body fluids, including sexual, blood and perinatal routes.
records.western_pathology_zh: HIV 感染並耗損 CD4 免疫細胞，削弱宿主防禦能力，若未控制則增加伺機性感染風險。
records.western_pathology_en: HIV infects and depletes CD4 immune cells, impairing host defense and increasing opportunistic disease risk when uncontrolled.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：HIV 感染與愛滋病（第三期疾病）相關但不可互換，兩者為不同疾病階段。

臨床表現：急性感染可能出現類流感症狀或無症狀；慢性感染可能多年無症狀。

重要特徵：須經檢測才能得知感染狀態、確診者皆建議接受抗反轉錄病毒治療、病毒量受抑制可預防性傳染、伺機性感染風險依免疫狀態而定。

診斷方法：CDC 建議之 HIV 抗原／抗體及補充檢測流程；病毒量與 CD4 用於監測治療與疾病狀態。

鑑別診斷：其他急性病毒性疾病、原發性免疫缺乏、藥物相關血球低下。

西醫治療：確診後開始並持續合併抗反轉錄病毒治療；預防／治療伺機性感染並提供預防性照護。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: HIV infection and AIDS/stage 3 disease are related but not interchangeable identities.

Clinical presentation: Acute infection may cause flu-like illness or no symptoms; chronic infection can remain asymptomatic for years.

Key features: testing is required to know status, ART for all diagnosed people, viral suppression prevents sexual transmission, opportunistic risk depends on immune status.

Diagnostic approach: CDC HIV antigen/antibody and supplemental testing algorithms; viral load and CD4 monitor treatment/disease.

Differential diagnosis: other acute viral illnesses, primary immunodeficiency, medication-related cytopenia.

Western treatment: Start and maintain combination antiretroviral therapy; prevent/treat opportunistic infections and address preventive care.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 未使用防護措施之高風險性行為

red_flags_zh.rationale: 免疫低下者可能迅速惡化

red_flags_en.rationale: Immunosuppressed patients can deteriorate rapidly
May indicate CNS opportunistic infection
May indicate severe opportunistic pulmonary infection

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 須考量免疫狀態、神經病變與藥物交互作用
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的感染科／愛滋病照護醫師聯絡協調照護，不建議病人自行停用抗反轉錄病毒治療

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Use standard precautions universally; HIV status alone is not a reason to refuse care
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Coordinate around immune status, neuropathy and medication interactions
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's infectious-disease/HIV clinician to coordinate care; do not advise the patient to stop antiretroviral therapy

records.summary_zh: 梅毒是由梅毒螺旋體引起的全身性性傳染疾病，未治療會歷經初期、二期、潛伏期與三期進展。
records.summary_en: Syphilis is a systemic sexually transmitted infection caused by Treponema pallidum that progresses through primary, secondary, latent and tertiary stages if untreated.
records.etiology_zh: 透過性行為傳染及懷孕期間垂直傳染；病原體為梅毒螺旋體。
records.etiology_en: Sexual transmission and vertical transmission during pregnancy; caused by T. pallidum.
records.western_pathology_zh: 螺旋體全身性擴散並可潛伏存在，之後侵犯神經、心血管及其他組織。
records.western_pathology_en: Spirochetes disseminate systemically and can persist latently, later injuring nervous, cardiovascular and other tissues.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：分期決定臨床表現、治療期程與追蹤方式；神經梅毒、眼梅毒與耳梅毒可能發生於任何分期。

臨床表現：初期出現無痛性硬性下疳；二期出現包含掌蹠之皮疹與全身症狀；潛伏期無症狀；三期出現神經／心血管／樹膠腫性病變。

重要特徵：分期性性傳染病、血清學檢測為主、盤尼西林治療可治癒、神經／眼／耳受累可能發生於任何分期。

診斷方法：血清學檢測，特定情況輔以病灶直接檢測；必要時進行腦脊髓液／眼／聽力評估。

鑑別診斷：其他生殖器潰瘍病因、病毒性皮疹、自體免疫性皮疹、其他造成神經／眼部疾病之病因。

西醫治療：依分期／表現選擇盤尼西林療程；性伴侶、懷孕及追蹤檢測須依指引處理。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Stage determines presentation, treatment duration and follow-up; neurosyphilis, ocular syphilis and otosyphilis can occur.

Clinical presentation: Primary painless chancre; secondary rash including palms/soles and systemic symptoms; latent asymptomatic; tertiary neurologic/cardiovascular/gummatous disease.

Key features: staged STI, serologic testing, curable with penicillin, neuro/ocular/otic involvement may occur at any stage.

Diagnostic approach: Serologic testing and direct lesion testing in selected cases; CSF/ocular/auditory assessment when indicated.

Differential diagnosis: other genital ulcers, viral exanthem, autoimmune rash, other causes of neuro/ocular disease.

Western treatment: Penicillin regimen depends on stage/manifestation; partners, pregnancy and follow-up testing require guideline-directed care.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 唐氏症是由第 21 對染色體多出的染色體物質造成的染色體疾患，伴隨特徵性的發展、認知與多重器官系統健康特徵。
records.summary_en: Down syndrome is a chromosomal condition caused by extra chromosome 21 material and is associated with characteristic developmental, cognitive and multisystem health features.
records.etiology_zh: 多出的第 21 對染色體物質，多數源自於隨機的細胞分裂錯誤；部分轉位型病例可能遺傳自帶有平衡性轉位的父母。
records.etiology_en: Extra chromosome 21 material, usually from a random cell-division error; some translocation cases can be inherited from a balanced-translocation parent.
records.western_pathology_zh: 基因劑量效應改變腦部、心臟、免疫、內分泌等多系統的發育。
records.western_pathology_en: Gene-dosage effects alter development across brain, heart, immune, endocrine and other systems.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：多數病例為第 21 對染色體之三染色體症；也存在轉位型與鑲嵌型。這是一種終身性遺傳疾患，需要個人化的健康監測，不是可以「治癒」的疾病。

臨床表現：程度不一之智能／發展障礙、肌張力低下與特徵性外觀；可能合併先天性心臟病、聽力、視力、甲狀腺、腸胃及血液系統相關疾患。

重要特徵：以第 21 對染色體三染色體症最常見、須多系統健康監測、個體差異大、先天性心臟病／聽力／甲狀腺風險提高。

診斷方法：產前篩檢／診斷性檢測，或出生後染色體分析確診。

鑑別診斷：其他染色體／發展性症候群。

西醫治療：無單一疾病治療方式；依個人狀況提供發展支持與終身各系統的預防／專科照護。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Most cases are trisomy 21 from nondisjunction; translocation and mosaic forms exist. It is not a disease to be 'cured' but a lifelong genetic condition requiring individualized health surveillance.

Clinical presentation: Variable intellectual/developmental disability, hypotonia and characteristic physical features; associated congenital heart, hearing, vision, thyroid, GI and hematologic conditions.

Key features: trisomy 21 most common form, multisystem surveillance, wide individual variation, increased congenital heart/hearing/thyroid risks.

Diagnostic approach: Prenatal screening/diagnostic testing or postnatal chromosome analysis confirms diagnosis.

Differential diagnosis: other chromosomal/developmental syndromes.

Western treatment: No single disease treatment; developmental supports and condition-specific preventive/specialty care throughout life.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_zh.finding: 急性症狀（依併發之器官系統疾患而定）
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 依相關器官系統病況轉診評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 唐氏症患者的先天性心臟病等共病可能影響急症表現與處置

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Refer for evaluation per the relevant organ-system condition
red_flags_en.rationale: Congenital heart disease and other comorbidities in Down syndrome can affect emergency presentation and management

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Refer for evaluation before manual therapy or exercise
red_flags_en.rationale: Cervical instability can affect procedure/exercise safety in some individuals

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 治療前確認心臟、頸椎、感覺與溝通需求，不預設刻板印象
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的專科照護團隊（心臟科、聽力／視力等）聯絡確認共病狀態

acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Confirm cardiac, cervical-spine, sensory and communication needs without stereotyping
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's specialty care team (cardiology, hearing/vision, etc.) to confirm comorbidity status

records.summary_zh: 馬凡氏症候群是由 FBN1 基因變異造成的體染色體顯性結締組織疾患，可能影響主動脈、心臟瓣膜、眼睛與骨骼。
records.summary_en: Marfan syndrome is an autosomal-dominant connective-tissue disorder caused by FBN1 variants that can affect the aorta, heart valves, eyes and skeleton.
records.etiology_zh: FBN1 致病性基因變異；部分病例為遺傳，部分為新發突變。
records.etiology_en: Pathogenic variants in FBN1; some cases inherited and others de novo.
records.western_pathology_zh: 纖維蛋白-1／微纖維缺陷使結締組織強度減弱，並使生長因子訊號失調。
records.western_pathology_en: Defective fibrillin-1/microfibrils weaken connective tissue and dysregulate growth-factor signaling.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：主動脈根部病變與水晶體異位是主要診斷／處置重點特徵，表現型差異極大。

臨床表現：身材高瘦、指趾細長、骨骼變形、水晶體異位／近視、主動脈擴張／動脈瘤與瓣膜疾病。

重要特徵：FBN1 結締組織疾患、主動脈瘤／剝離風險、水晶體異位、體染色體顯性遺傳。

診斷方法：臨床 Ghent 準則、家族史、心血管／眼科評估及基因檢測。

鑑別診斷：Loeys-Dietz 症候群、血管型 Ehlers-Danlos 症候群、同半胱胺酸尿症、家族性胸主動脈瘤。

西醫治療：定期主動脈影像追蹤、血壓／心率管理，並於適當時機進行預防性主動脈手術；眼科／骨科照護。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Aortic-root disease and ectopia lentis are major diagnostic/management features; phenotype varies widely.

Clinical presentation: Tall/slender habitus, long digits, skeletal deformity, lens dislocation/myopia, aortic dilation/aneurysm and valve disease.

Key features: FBN1 connective-tissue disorder, aortic aneurysm/dissection risk, ectopia lentis, autosomal dominant.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical Ghent-style criteria, family history, cardiovascular/eye evaluation and genetic testing.

Differential diagnosis: Loeys-Dietz syndrome, vascular EDS, homocystinuria, familial thoracic aortic aneurysm.

Western treatment: Regular aortic imaging, blood-pressure/heart-rate management and prophylactic aortic surgery when indicated; eye/skeletal care.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 癌症是一大類疾病的總稱，特徵為異常細胞不受控制地生長、侵犯組織並可能轉移；部位、組織學、分期與生物標記決定其臨床意義。此為總類導覽卡，不取代部位專屬的正典癌症卡片。
records.summary_en: Cancer is a large family of diseases in which abnormal cells grow uncontrollably, invade tissues and may metastasize. Site, histology, stage and biomarkers determine clinical meaning. This is a generic navigational parent card, not a replacement for site-specific canonical cancers.
records.etiology_zh: 癌症源自於累積的基因體／表觀基因體變異，受年齡、遺傳易感性、暴露因子、感染及隨機細胞歷程共同影響。
records.etiology_en: Cancer arises from accumulated genomic/epigenomic alterations influenced by age, inherited susceptibility, exposures, infections and random cellular processes.
records.western_pathology_zh: 惡性細胞逃脫生長調控、侵犯局部組織、招募血液供應，並可能經淋巴／血流擴散至遠處器官。
records.western_pathology_en: Malignant cells escape growth controls, invade local tissue, recruit blood supply and may spread through lymph/blood to distant organs.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：此總類卡用於導覽與跨科共同照護，不應取代部位專屬的正典癌症卡（如乳癌、攝護腺癌、大腸直腸癌、肺癌，見本批次其他卡片）。與 cond.cancer_supportive（腫瘤支持照護）為互補而非等同：後者聚焦症狀／副作用管理，本卡聚焦疾病本身的識別與分期邏輯。

臨床表現：因部位而異；可能出現不明原因持續腫塊、出血、體重減輕、疼痛、器官功能障礙，或篩檢時無症狀發現。

重要特徵：異質性疾病家族、多數診斷需組織病理確認、分期決定預後與治療、治療副作用為重要共同照護議題。

診斷方法：部位專屬之影像／內視鏡／檢驗，多數癌症接續進行組織診斷與分期。

鑑別診斷：良性腫瘤、感染／發炎、部位專屬之類似病灶。

西醫治療：依癌症種類／分期選擇手術、放射治療、全身性治療（細胞毒性、內分泌、標靶、免疫治療）及支持性／緩和照護。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須依部位、組織學及當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: A generic cancer parent is useful for navigation/co-management but should not replace site-specific canonical cancers (breast, prostate, colorectal, lung — see other cards in this batch). Complementary to, not equivalent to, cond.cancer_supportive (cancer supportive care): that card focuses on symptom/side-effect management, this card focuses on identifying and staging the disease itself.

Clinical presentation: Varies by site; unexplained persistent masses, bleeding, weight loss, pain, organ dysfunction or no symptoms on screening.

Key features: heterogeneous disease family, biopsy/pathology defines many diagnoses, stage drives prognosis/treatment, treatment adverse effects are major co-management issue.

Diagnostic approach: Site-specific imaging/endoscopy/labs followed by tissue diagnosis in many cancers and staging.

Differential diagnosis: benign tumors, infection/inflammation, site-specific mimics.

Western treatment: Surgery, radiation, systemic therapy (cytotoxic, endocrine, targeted, immunotherapy) and supportive/palliative care based on cancer type/stage.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection depends on site, histology and the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review.

records.summary_zh: 乳癌是發生於乳房組織的惡性腫瘤，最常源自導管或小葉上皮，具多種生物學亞型。
records.summary_en: Breast cancer is malignant growth arising in breast tissue, most commonly from ductal or lobular epithelium, with diverse biologic subtypes.
records.etiology_zh: 風險反映年齡、性別、遺傳變異／家族史，以及生殖／荷爾蒙與生活型態／暴露因子。
records.etiology_en: Risk reflects age, sex, inherited variants/family history, reproductive/hormonal and lifestyle/exposure factors.
records.western_pathology_zh: 惡性乳房細胞侵犯周圍組織，並可能擴散至局部淋巴結及遠處器官。
records.western_pathology_en: Malignant breast cells invade surrounding tissue and can spread to regional nodes and distant organs.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：包含原位與侵犯性病灶及分子亞型；良性乳房腫塊不是癌症。

臨床表現：多由篩檢發現；可能出現乳房／腋下腫塊、皮膚／乳頭變化、分泌物或形狀改變。早期病灶可能無症狀。

重要特徵：篩檢可偵測無症狀疾病、組織切片為診斷依據、ER／PR／HER2 生物標記具重要意義、分期／亞型決定治療。

診斷方法：適當之診斷性乳房攝影／超音波／MRI，隨後進行切片與受體／病理檢測；必要時進行分期。

鑑別診斷：纖維腺瘤、囊腫、乳腺炎、良性乳房變化。

西醫治療：依亞型／分期選擇手術、放射治療及全身性內分泌、化療、HER2 標靶或其他標靶／免疫治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Breast cancer includes in-situ and invasive entities and molecular subtypes; benign breast lumps are not cancer.

Clinical presentation: Often screen-detected; possible breast/axillary lump, skin/nipple changes, discharge or shape change. Early disease may be asymptomatic.

Key features: screening detects asymptomatic disease, tissue biopsy diagnosis, ER/PR/HER2 biomarkers matter, stage/subtype guide treatment.

Diagnostic approach: Diagnostic mammography/ultrasound/MRI as appropriate followed by biopsy and receptor/pathology testing; staging when indicated.

Differential diagnosis: fibroadenoma, cyst, mastitis, benign breast change.

Western treatment: Surgery, radiation and systemic endocrine, chemotherapy, HER2-targeted or other targeted/immunotherapies according to subtype/stage.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 攝護腺癌是發生於攝護腺的惡性腫瘤，多為腺癌，病程從惰性局限性疾病到轉移性癌症不等。
records.summary_en: Prostate cancer is malignancy arising in the prostate, commonly adenocarcinoma, ranging from indolent localized disease to metastatic cancer.
records.etiology_zh: 年齡、家族／遺傳因子及族裔背景影響風險。
records.etiology_en: Age, family/genetic factors and ancestry influence risk.
records.western_pathology_zh: 惡性攝護腺上皮細胞可能維持局限，也可能擴散，常見轉移至骨骼與淋巴結。
records.western_pathology_en: Malignant prostate epithelial cells may remain localized or spread, commonly to bone and lymph nodes.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：攝護腺癌與良性攝護腺增生（cond.bph）及攝護腺炎（cond.chronic_prostatitis）為不同疾病；泌尿症狀不具特異性，不能用以區分三者。

臨床表現：早期常無症狀；晚期可能出現泌尿症狀、血尿／血精，或持續性骨盆／骨骼疼痛。

重要特徵：多數生長緩慢但具異質性、PSA 本身不具診斷性、切片為確診依據、部分低風險個案適合主動監測。

診斷方法：PSA／肛門指診風險評估、攝護腺 MRI 及切片；依風險程度進行分期影像。

鑑別診斷：良性攝護腺增生、攝護腺炎、泌尿道感染、其他癌症之骨骼轉移。

西醫治療：依分期／風險選擇主動監測、手術、放射治療、雄性素剝奪／荷爾蒙治療及全身性治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Prostate cancer is distinct from BPH and prostatitis; urinary symptoms are not specific.

Clinical presentation: Often asymptomatic early; advanced disease may cause urinary symptoms, hematuria/hematospermia or persistent bone/pelvic pain.

Key features: often slow-growing but heterogeneous, PSA is not diagnostic alone, biopsy defines cancer, active surveillance appropriate for selected low-risk disease.

Diagnostic approach: PSA/DRE risk assessment, prostate MRI and biopsy; staging imaging based on risk.

Differential diagnosis: BPH, prostatitis, UTI, metastatic bone disease from other cancer.

Western treatment: Active surveillance, surgery, radiation, androgen-deprivation/hormonal therapy and systemic treatments based on stage/risk.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

可能造成腎功能損傷
已知癌症患者可能提示骨轉移

records.summary_zh: 大腸直腸癌是發生於結腸或直腸的惡性腫瘤，多經由前驅性息肉發展而成，預後與分期高度相關。
records.summary_en: Colorectal cancer is malignancy arising in the colon or rectum, often developing through precursor polyps and with outcomes strongly influenced by stage.
records.etiology_zh: 年齡、遺傳症候群／家族史、發炎性腸道疾病及生活型態／代謝因子皆有影響。
records.etiology_en: Age, inherited syndromes/family history, IBD and lifestyle/metabolic factors contribute.
records.western_pathology_zh: 腺瘤性或鋸齒狀前驅病灶累積分子變異，逐漸進展為侵犯性與轉移性疾病。
records.western_pathology_en: Adenomatous or serrated precursor pathways accumulate molecular alterations, progressing to invasive and metastatic disease.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：與 cond.ibd（發炎性腸道疾病）為不同疾病，但長期發炎性腸道疾病是危險因子之一；良性息肉不是癌症。

臨床表現：篩檢可能發現無症狀病灶；可出現血便、排便習慣改變、缺鐵性貧血、腹痛或體重減輕。

重要特徵：篩檢／預防具重要性、息肉為前驅病灶、缺鐵性貧血可為線索、需組織診斷並分期。

診斷方法：大腸鏡併切片；CT／MRI 及腫瘤標記輔助分期與追蹤，非單獨診斷依據。

鑑別診斷：發炎性腸道疾病、痔瘡、憩室疾病、腸躁症、其他消化道出血病因。

西醫治療：手術合併依分期／部位選擇之化學治療、放射治療（尤其直腸個案）及標靶／免疫治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Distinct from cond.ibd (inflammatory bowel disease), though long-standing IBD is a risk factor; benign polyps are not cancer.

Clinical presentation: May be asymptomatic on screening; blood in stool, change in bowel habits, iron-deficiency anemia, abdominal pain or weight loss can occur.

Key features: screening/prevention important, polyps precursor, iron-deficiency anemia can be clue, tissue diagnosis + staging.

Diagnostic approach: Colonoscopy with biopsy; CT/MRI and tumor markers support staging/follow-up, not standalone diagnosis.

Differential diagnosis: IBD, hemorrhoids, diverticular disease, IBS, other GI bleeding causes.

Western treatment: Surgery plus stage/site-specific chemotherapy, radiation (especially rectal contexts) and targeted/immunotherapy based on tumor features.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 肺癌是發生於肺部組織的惡性疾病，主要分為非小細胞肺癌與小細胞肺癌，生物特性與治療方式不同。
records.summary_en: Lung cancer is malignant disease arising in lung tissue, broadly divided into non-small cell and small cell lung cancer with different biology and treatment.
records.etiology_zh: 菸草煙霧為主要危險因子；氡氣、職業／環境暴露及遺傳因子亦有影響，非吸菸者也可能罹患肺癌。
records.etiology_en: Tobacco smoke is a major risk factor; radon, occupational/environmental exposures and genetic factors also contribute, and nonsmokers can develop lung cancer.
records.western_pathology_zh: 惡性肺部細胞侵犯局部結構，並可能擴散至淋巴結、腦部、骨骼、肝臟等部位。
records.western_pathology_en: Malignant pulmonary cells invade local structures and spread to nodes, brain, bone, liver and other sites.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：持續性咳嗽或肺部結節不必然等於肺癌，須以組織學與分期確立診斷。

臨床表現：可能無症狀；持續／改變性咳嗽、咳血、胸痛、呼吸困難、體重減輕、聲音沙啞或反覆肺炎可能出現。

重要特徵：非小細胞肺癌與小細胞肺癌區分、符合條件之高風險族群可進行低劑量電腦斷層篩檢、須切片／分子檢測、有特定轉移型態。

診斷方法：胸部影像後接續組織診斷；分期與分子生物標記檢測指引治療。

鑑別診斷：肺炎、結核病、良性肺結節、慢性阻塞性肺病、其他癌症之肺轉移。

西醫治療：依組織學／分期／生物標記選擇手術、放射治療、化學治療、標靶治療及免疫治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Persistent cough or a lung nodule is not automatically cancer; histology and stage define disease.

Clinical presentation: May be asymptomatic; persistent/change in cough, hemoptysis, chest pain, dyspnea, weight loss, hoarseness or recurrent pneumonia can occur.

Key features: NSCLC vs SCLC, screening LDCT for eligible high-risk people, biopsy/molecular testing, metastatic patterns.

Diagnostic approach: Chest imaging followed by tissue diagnosis; staging and molecular biomarker testing guide treatment.

Differential diagnosis: pneumonia, TB, benign pulmonary nodule, COPD, metastatic cancer.

Western treatment: Surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, targeted therapy and immunotherapy based on histology/stage/biomarkers.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 僅作為治療副作用的輔助照護
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 須考量低血氧、抗凝血狀態、血球低下、放射治療範圍與骨轉移風險
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的腫瘤科醫師聯絡確認治療階段
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch N Genetic/Oncology（依據 NCI 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於肺癌的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Adjunctive symptom/side-effect care only; consider hypoxia, anticoagulation, cytopenias, radiation fields and metastatic bone risk
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Coordinate around treatment status and organ function
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's oncologist to confirm treatment phase
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch N Genetic/Oncology (compiled from NCI clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for lung cancer was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution
